units.en: Prince Xian of Anping, Sima Fu.

units.zh: 安平獻王孚，字叔達，宣帝次弟也。
units.en: Sima Fu, Prince Xian of Anping, styled Shuda, was the younger brother who followed Emperor Xuan (Sima Yi).
units.literal: Prince Xian of Anping, Sima Fu, courtesy name Shuda, was Emperor Xuan's next younger brother.

units.zh: 初，孚長兄朗字伯達，宣帝字仲達，孚弟馗字季達，恂字顯達，進字惠達，通字雅達，敏字幼達，俱知名，故時號為「八達」焉。
units.en: At first Fu's eldest brother Lang had courtesy name Boda; Emperor Xuan had courtesy name Zhongda; Fu's younger brothers were Kui, courtesy Jida; Xun, Xianda; Jin, Huida; Tong, Yada; and Min, Youda; all were renowned, so people at the time called them the 'Eight Worthies.'
units.literal: At first Fu's eldest brother Lang had courtesy name Boda; Emperor Xuan had courtesy name Zhongda; Fu's younger brothers were Kui, courtesy Jida; Xun, Xianda; Jin, Huida; Tong, Yada; and Min, Youda; all were renowned, so people at the time called them the 'Eight Worthies.'

units.zh: 孚溫厚廉讓，博涉經史。
units.en: Warm, modest, and widely read in classical texts and history, he carried himself with unassuming grace.
units.literal: Fu was warm and generous, honest and yielding, and broadly read the Classics and histories.

units.zh: 漢末喪亂，與兄弟處危亡之中，簞食瓢飲，而披閱不倦。
units.en: Through the Han collapse he and his brothers lived on the verge of ruin on the plainest fare, yet he never tired of his books.
units.literal: At the end of the Han there was turmoil and disorder; with his brothers he dwelt amid peril and extinction, eating from bamboo baskets and drinking from gourd dippers, yet he wearied not of reading.

units.zh: 性通恕，以貞白自立，未嘗有怨於人。
units.en: Forgiving by temperament and upright in reputation, he kept himself blameless and bore no grudges.
units.literal: By nature he was open and forgiving; by purity and integrity he established himself, and he never harbored resentment toward anyone.

units.zh: 陳留殷武有名於海內，嘗罹罪譴，孚往省之，遂與同處分食，談者稱焉。
units.en: When Yin Wu of Chenliu—a man celebrated empire-wide—was censured and punished, Fu called on him and stayed to share quarters and meals; observers admired his loyalty.
units.literal: Yin Wu of Chenliu had renown throughout the realm; he once suffered condemnation for an offense. Fu went to visit him and shared lodging and divided food with him; those who spoke of it praised him.

units.zh: 魏陳思王植有俊才，清選官屬，以孚為文學掾。
units.en: Cao Zhi, Wei Prince Si of Chen, culled his staff for excellence and named Fu literary adjutant.
units.literal: Prince Si of Chen of Wei, Cao Zhi, had outstanding talent; in cleanly selecting officials he appointed Fu as literary aide.

units.zh: 植負才陵物，孚每切諫，初不合意，後乃謝之。
units.en: Cao Zhi's brilliance made him imperious; Fu rebuked him sharply until, though initially offended, Cao Zhi came to apologize.
units.literal: Zhi relied on his talent and looked down on others; Fu often remonstrated sternly. At first this did not suit Zhi's wishes, but afterward Zhi apologized to him.

units.zh: 遷太子中庶子。
units.en: He was promoted to palace attendant to the heir apparent.
units.literal: He was transferred to Palace Grandee for the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 魏武帝崩，太子號哭過甚，孚諫曰：「大行晏駕，天下恃殿下為命。
units.en: When Wei Emperor Wu died, the heir apparent wailed excessively in grief. Fu remonstrated, saying, 'The late emperor has passed away; the realm depends upon Your Highness as its lifeline.
units.literal: When Wei Emperor Wu died, the heir apparent wailed excessively in grief. Fu remonstrated, saying, 'The late emperor has passed away; the realm depends upon Your Highness as its lifeline.

units.zh: 當上為宗廟，下為萬國，奈何效匹夫之孝乎！」
units.en: Above you must serve the ancestral temple; below you must serve the myriad states—how can you imitate the filial piety of a common man!'
units.literal: Above you must serve the ancestral temple; below you must serve the myriad states—how can you imitate the filial piety of a common man!'

units.zh: 太子良久乃止，曰：「卿言是也。」
units.en: The heir apparent after a long while stopped and said, 'What you say is right.'
units.literal: The heir apparent after a long while stopped and said, 'What you say is right.'

units.zh: 時群臣初聞帝崩，相聚號哭，無復行列。
units.en: The officials, thunderstruck by the news, had crowded together weeping without discipline or formation.
units.literal: At that time when the ministers first heard the emperor had died, they gathered together and wailed; there was no longer any order of ranks.

units.zh: 孚厲聲於朝曰：「今大行晏駕，天下震動，當早拜嗣君，以鎮海內，而但哭邪！」
units.en: Fu thundered in court: 'Now the late emperor has passed away and the realm is shaken; we should promptly install the successor to stabilize the realm within the seas—and yet you only weep!'
units.literal: Fu thundered in court: 'Now the late emperor has passed away and the realm is shaken; we should promptly install the successor to stabilize the realm within the seas—and yet you only weep!'

units.zh: 孚與尚書和洽罷群臣，備禁衛，具喪事，奉太子以即位，是為文帝。
units.en: With Minister He Qia he dispersed the disorderly crowd, secured the palace guard, ordered the obsequies, and invested the crown prince, who ascended as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: Fu together with Minister of Writing He Qia dismissed the assembled ministers, prepared the palace guards, arranged the funeral observances, and presented the heir apparent to assume the throne—this was Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 時當選侍中、常侍等官，太子左右舊人頗諷諭主者，便欲就用，不調餘人。
units.en: When posts such as palace attendant were to be filled, the prince's old companions leaned on the selectors to secure their own appointments and shut out outsiders.
units.literal: At that time when selecting Palace Attendants and Regular Attendants and such offices, the heir apparent's former intimates largely hinted to those in charge that they wished to be appointed at once without transferring others.

units.zh: 孚曰：「雖有堯舜，必有稷契。
units.en: Fu said, 'Though there be Yao and Shun, there must still be Ji and Xie.
units.literal: Fu said, 'Though there be Yao and Shun, there must still be Ji and Xie.

units.zh: 今嗣君新立，當進用海內英賢，猶患不得，如何欲因際會自相薦舉邪！
units.en: Now the successor has newly been established; we ought to advance and employ worthy men from within the realm—we still fear we cannot obtain enough; how can we wish to seize the occasion to recommend ourselves!
units.literal: Now the successor has newly been established; we ought to advance and employ worthy men from within the realm—we still fear we cannot obtain enough; how can we wish to seize the occasion to recommend ourselves!

units.zh: 官失其任，得者亦不足貴。」
units.en: If offices miss their proper appointments, even those who obtain them are not worth esteeming.'
units.literal: If offices miss their proper appointments, even those who obtain them are not worth esteeming.'

units.zh: 遂更他選。
units.en: The slate was cleared and a fresh round of appointments chosen.
units.literal: Thereupon they changed and made other selections.

units.zh: 轉孚為中書郎、給事常侍，宿省內，除黃門侍郎，加騎都尉。
units.en: He moved to secretariat attendant and duty regular attendant, billeted inside the palace; then yellow-gate gentleman with supernumerary chief commandant of cavalry.
units.literal: Fu was transferred to Palace Secretariat Gentleman and Serving Regular Attendant, lodged inside the palace overnight; he was appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman and additionally conferred Chief Commandant of Cavalry.

units.zh: 時孫權稱籓，請送任子，當遣前將軍于禁還，久而不至。
units.en: Sun Quan had submitted as a tributary and offered to send a royal hostage and return the captive Yu Jin—but neither pledge appeared.
units.literal: At that time Sun Quan declared himself a vassal and requested to send a hostage son; it was intended to send back former general Yu Jin, but after a long time he still had not arrived.

units.zh: 天子以問孚，孚曰：「先王設九服之制，誠以要荒難以德懷，不以諸夏禮責也。
units.en: The Son of Heaven asked Fu about it. Fu said, 'The former kings established the nine domains system—truly because the distant and wild regions are hard to win by virtue alone, and they did not hold them to Central States ritual.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven asked Fu about it. Fu said, 'The former kings established the nine domains system—truly because the distant and wild regions are hard to win by virtue alone, and they did not hold them to Central States ritual.

units.zh: 陛下承緒，遠人率貢。
units.en: Your Majesty carries on the succession; distant peoples all come bearing tribute.
units.literal: Your Majesty carries on the succession; distant peoples all come bearing tribute.

units.zh: 權雖未送任子，於禁不至，猶宜以寬待之，畜養士馬，以觀其變。
units.en: Though Quan has not yet sent the hostage son and Yu Jin has not arrived, still it is fitting to treat him generously, nurture soldiers and horses, and observe how matters change.
units.literal: Though Quan has not yet sent the hostage son and Yu Jin has not arrived, still it is fitting to treat him generously, nurture soldiers and horses, and observe how matters change.

units.zh: 不可以嫌疑責讓，恐傷懷遠之義。
units.en: One must not on account of suspicion reproach and blame him, lest one wound the principle of cherishing those far away.
units.literal: One must not on account of suspicion reproach and blame him, lest one wound the principle of cherishing those far away.

units.zh: 自孫策至權，奕世相繼，惟強與弱，不在一禁，禁之未至，當有他故耳。」
units.en: From Sun Ce down to Quan, generations succeed one another; strength and weakness lie not in one Yu Jin; when Jin does not arrive, there ought to be another reason.'
units.literal: From Sun Ce down to Quan, generations succeed one another; strength and weakness lie not in one Yu Jin; when Jin does not arrive, there ought to be another reason.'

units.zh: 後禁至，果以疾遲留，而任子竟不至。
units.en: Yu Jin eventually appeared, detained by illness as Fu predicted, yet the hostage never followed.
units.literal: Afterward Jin arrived; indeed he had delayed because of illness, yet in the end the hostage son never came.

units.zh: 大軍臨江，責其違言，吳遂絕不貢獻。
units.en: Once imperial troops stood on the river and challenged Wu's breach of faith, tribute from the south stopped altogether.
units.literal: When the great army reached the Yangzi they blamed Wu for breaking its word, and Wu then utterly ceased tribute.

units.zh: 後出為河內典農，賜爵關內侯，轉清河太守。
units.en: He later served as Henei agrarian director, received a secondary marquisate within the passes, then governed Qinghe.
units.literal: Later he went out as Agrarian Director for Henei, was enfeoffed with rank of district marquis within the passes, and transferred to governor of Qinghe.

units.zh: 初，魏文帝置度支尚書，專掌軍國支計，朝議以征討未息，動須節量。
units.en: Emperor Wen had created the revenue ministry for military supply; court opinion stressed ongoing campaigns meant every outlay needed restraint.
units.literal: At first Wei Emperor Wen established the Minister of Revenue to specialize in army and state expenditures; court discussion held that with expeditions still unfinished, movements constantly required moderation.

units.zh: 及明帝嗣位，欲用孚，問左右曰：「有兄風不？」
units.en: When Emperor Ming succeeded to the throne and wished to employ Fu, he asked those around him, "Does he have his elder brother's manner?"
units.literal: When Emperor Ming succeeded to the throne and wished to employ Fu, he asked those around him, "Does he have his elder brother's manner?"

units.zh: 答云：「似兄。」
units.en: They answered, "He resembles his elder brother."
units.literal: They answered, "He resembles his elder brother."

units.zh: 天子曰：「吾得司馬懿二人，復何憂哉！」
units.en: The Son of Heaven said, 'If I obtain two Sima Yis, what else need I worry about!'
units.literal: The Son of Heaven said, 'If I obtain two Sima Yis, what else need I worry about!'

units.zh: 轉為度支尚書。
units.en: He was named minister of revenue.
units.literal: Fu was transferred to Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 孚以為擒敵制勝，宜有備預。
units.en: Fu insisted victory required planning ahead.
units.literal: Fu held that to seize the enemy and achieve victory there ought to be preparedness beforehand.

units.zh: 每諸葛亮入寇關中，邊兵不能制敵，中軍奔赴，輒不及事機，宜預選步騎二萬，以為二部，為討賊之備。
units.en: Each time Zhuge Liang struck Guanzhong the border garrisons buckled while reinforcements arrived too late; Fu urged standing two corps of twenty thousand foot and horse in readiness.
units.literal: Whenever Zhuge Liang invaded Guanzhong, the frontier troops could not check the enemy and the central army rushed to the rescue but always missed the moment; he proposed beforehand to select twenty thousand infantry and cavalry and divide them into two corps as preparations for punishing the rebels.

units.zh: 又以關中連遭賊寇，穀帛不足，遣冀州農丁五千屯於上邽，秋冬習戰陣，春夏修田桑。
units.en: With Guanzhong stripped by raids and short of grain and cloth, he relocated five thousand Ji cultivators to Shanggui to drill in winter and farm in summer.
units.literal: Also because Guanzhong had repeatedly suffered bandit raids and grain and silk were insufficient, he sent five thousand farming households from Ji Province to garrison Shanggui; in autumn and winter they drilled battle formations, in spring and summer they tended fields and mulberries.

units.zh: 由是關中軍國有餘，待賊有備矣。
units.en: The western theater grew solvent while keeping the foe under watch.
units.literal: By this means Guanzhong's army and state had surplus and awaited the enemy prepared.

units.zh: 後除尚書右僕射，進爵昌平亭侯，遷尚書令。
units.en: He rose to right vice director of the secretariat, marquis of Changping ting, then director.
units.literal: Later he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, advanced in rank to Marquis of Changping precinct, and promoted Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 及大將軍曹爽擅權，李勝、何晏、鄧颺等亂政，孚不視庶事，但正身遠害而已。
units.en: Under Cao Shuang's dictatorship and the cabal of Li Sheng, He Yan, and Deng Yang, Fu withdrew from daily administration and merely kept his head down.
units.literal: When Grand General Cao Shuang monopolized power and Li Sheng, He Yan, Deng Yang, and others threw government into chaos, Fu did not attend to routine affairs but simply corrected himself and kept distant from harm.

units.zh: 及宣帝誅爽，孚與景帝屯司馬門，以功進爵長社縣侯，加侍中。
units.en: When Sima Yi struck down Shuang, Fu and Sima Shi sealed Sima Gate; for that service he became marquis of Changshe and palace attendant.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan executed Shuang, Fu together with Emperor Jing held Sima Gate; by merit he advanced to marquis of Changshe county and was additionally appointed palace attendant.

units.zh: 時吳將諸葛恪圍新城，以孚進督諸軍二十萬防禦之。
units.en: As Wu's Zhuge Ke pressed Xincheng, Fu took overall command of two hundred thousand defenders.
units.literal: At that time Wu general Zhuge Ke besieged Xincheng; Fu was promoted to supervise two hundred thousand troops of all armies in defense.

units.zh: 孚次壽春，遣毌丘儉、文欽等進討。
units.en: He camped at Shouchun and sent Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin forward.
units.literal: Fu halted at Shouchun and dispatched Guanqiu Jian, Wen Qin, and others to advance and attack.

units.zh: 諸將欲速擊之，孚曰：「夫攻者，借人之力以為功，且當詐巧，不可力爭也。」
units.en: The generals wished to strike quickly; Fu said, 'In attacking, one borrows others' strength to accomplish merit, and moreover ought to rely on stratagem and cunning—one cannot contend by brute force.
units.literal: The generals wished to strike quickly; Fu said, 'In attacking, one borrows others' strength to accomplish merit, and moreover ought to rely on stratagem and cunning—one cannot contend by brute force.

units.zh: 故稽留月餘乃進軍，吳師望風而退。
units.en: He waited more than a month before marching, and the Wu host melted away at the news.
units.literal: Therefore he delayed over a month before advancing the army, and the Wu army withdrew at the rumor of his approach.

units.zh: 魏明悼後崩，議書銘旌，或欲去姓而書魏，或欲兩書，孚以為：「經典正義，皆不應書。
units.en: When Wei Empress Mingdao died, discussion turned to the funeral banner inscription; some wished to omit the surname and write only Wei, some wished to write both; Fu held: "According to canonical correctness, none of these should be written.
units.literal: When Wei Empress Mingdao died, discussion turned to the funeral banner inscription; some wished to omit the surname and write only Wei, some wished to write both; Fu held: "According to canonical correctness, none of these should be written.

units.zh: 凡帝王皆因本國之名以為天下之號，而與往代相別耳，非為擇美名以自光也。
units.en: In general emperors all take their state's name as the title for All Under Heaven in order to distinguish themselves from former dynasties; it is not that they choose a pretty name to glorify themselves.
units.literal: In general emperors all take their state's name as the title for All Under Heaven in order to distinguish themselves from former dynasties; it is not that they choose a pretty name to glorify themselves.

units.zh: 天稱皇天，則帝稱皇帝，地稱后土，則後稱皇后。
units.en: Heaven is called August Heaven, then the emperor is called August Emperor; earth is called sovereign earth, then the empress is called August Empress.
units.literal: Heaven is called August Heaven, then the emperor is called August Emperor; earth is called sovereign earth, then the empress is called August Empress.

units.zh: 此乃所以同天地之大號，流無二之尊名，不待稱國號以自表，不俟稱氏族以自彰。
units.en: This is how they share heaven and earth's great titles and spread an unrivaled honorific name—they need not add the state's name to distinguish themselves nor wait to declare clan surname to display themselves.
units.literal: This is how they share heaven and earth's great titles and spread an unrivaled honorific name—they need not add the state's name to distinguish themselves nor wait to declare clan surname to display themselves.

units.zh: 是以《春秋》隱公三年《經》曰'三月庚戌天王崩'，尊而稱天，不曰周王者，所以殊乎列國之君也。
units.en: Therefore in Duke Yin's third year the Classic records 'In the third month, on gengxu, the August Heaven King died,' honoring him by calling him Heaven and not saying King of Zhou in order to distinguish him from the lords of the states.
units.literal: Therefore in Duke Yin's third year the Classic records 'In the third month, on gengxu, the August Heaven King died,' honoring him by calling him Heaven and not saying King of Zhou in order to distinguish him from the lords of the states.

units.zh: '八月庚辰宋公和卒'，書國稱名，所以異乎天王也。
units.en: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Duke He of Song died—recording the state and personal name distinguishes him from the August Heaven King.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Duke He of Song died—recording the state and personal name distinguishes him from the August Heaven King.

units.zh: 襄公十五年《經》曰'劉夏逆王后于齊'，不雲逆周王后姜氏者，所以異乎列國之夫人也。
units.en: In Duke Xiang's fifteenth year the Classic says 'Liu Xia meets the queen consort at Qi' without saying he meets the Zhou queen consort Jiang—thereby distinguishing her from the wives of the states.
units.literal: In Duke Xiang's fifteenth year the Classic says 'Liu Xia meets the queen consort at Qi' without saying he meets the Zhou queen consort Jiang—thereby distinguishing her from the wives of the states.

units.zh: 至乎列國，則曰'夫人姜氏至自齊'，又曰'紀伯姬卒'，書國稱姓，此所以異乎天王後也。
units.en: As for the states it says 'Lady Jiang arrived from Qi' and also says 'Bo Ji of Ji died'—recording state and surname distinguishes them from the August Heaven's queen.
units.literal: As for the states it says 'Lady Jiang arrived from Qi' and also says 'Bo Ji of Ji died'—recording state and surname distinguishes them from the August Heaven's queen.

units.zh: 由此考之，尊稱皇帝，赫赫無二，何待魏乎？
units.en: Examining this, the honored title August Emperor shines unrivaled—why add Wei?
units.literal: Examining this, the honored title August Emperor shines unrivaled—why add Wei?

units.zh: 尊稱皇后，彰以諡號，何待於姓乎？
units.en: The honored title August Empress is displayed by posthumous title—why wait for the surname?
units.literal: The honored title August Empress is displayed by posthumous title—why wait for the surname?

units.zh: 議者欲書魏者，此以為天皇之尊，同于往古列國之君也。
units.en: Those who argue for writing Wei treat the celestial emperor's honor as equal to the feudal lords of old.
units.literal: Those who argue for writing Wei treat the celestial emperor's honor as equal to the feudal lords of old.

units.zh: 或欲書姓者，此以為天皇之後，同于往古之夫人也。
units.en: Those who argue for writing the surname treat the celestial consort as equal to the wives of old.
units.literal: Those who argue for writing the surname treat the celestial consort as equal to the wives of old.

units.zh: 乖經典之大義，異乎聖人之明制，非所以垂訓將來，為萬世不易之式者也。」
units.en: They violate the great meaning of the Classics and differ from the sage's clear institutions; they are not a way to instruct posterity or serve as an unchanging model for myriad generations."
units.literal: They violate the great meaning of the Classics and differ from the sage's clear institutions; they are not a way to instruct posterity or serve as an unchanging model for myriad generations."

units.zh: 遂從孚議。
units.en: The court adopted Fu's reading.
units.literal: Thereupon they followed Fu's proposal.

units.zh: 遷司空。
units.en: He became minister of works.
units.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 代王淩太尉。
units.en: He replaced Wang Ling as grand commandant.
units.literal: He succeeded Wang Ling as Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 及蜀將姜維寇隴右，雍州刺史王經戰敗，遣孚西鎮關中，統諸軍事。
units.en: After Jiang Wei struck Longyou and Yong inspector Wang Jing collapsed, Fu went west to steady Guanzhong with supreme command.
units.literal: When Shu general Jiang Wei raided Longyou, Inspector of Yong Province Wang Jing was defeated in battle; Fu was dispatched west to secure Guanzhong and command all military affairs.

units.zh: 征西將軍陳泰與安西將軍鄧艾進擊維，維退。
units.en: Chen Tai and Deng Ai drove Jiang Wei back.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the West Chen Tai and General Who Pacifies the West Deng Ai advanced and attacked Jiang Wei, and Jiang Wei withdrew.

units.zh: 孚還京師，轉太傅。
units.en: He returned to court as grand mentor.
units.literal: Fu returned to the capital and was transferred to Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 及高貴鄉公遭害，百官莫敢奔赴，孚枕屍於股，哭之慟，曰：「殺陛下者臣之罪。」
units.en: When the Duke of Gaoguixiang suffered violent death, none of the hundred officials dared go to the scene; Fu pillowed the corpse on his thigh, wept bitterly, and said, 'Those who killed Your Majesty are my crime.'
units.literal: When the Duke of Gaoguixiang suffered violent death, none of the hundred officials dared go to the scene; Fu pillowed the corpse on his thigh, wept bitterly, and said, 'Those who killed Your Majesty are my crime.'

units.zh: 奏推主者。
units.en: He filed charges against the ringleaders.
units.literal: He memorialized to pursue those responsible.

units.zh: 會太后令以庶人禮葬，孚與群公上表，乞以王禮葬，從之。
units.en: Though the empress dowager first demanded a commoner's funeral, Fu and his peers petitioned for kingly honors and won consent.
units.literal: When it happened that the empress dowager ordered burial by commoner rites, Fu together with the dukes submitted a memorial begging burial by princely rites; she assented.

units.zh: 孚性至慎。
units.en: By temperament he was exceedingly careful.
units.literal: Fu's nature was extremely cautious.

units.zh: 宣帝執政，常自退損。
units.en: Under Sima Yi's supremacy he habitually effaced himself.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan held power he often withdrew and diminished himself.

units.zh: 後逢廢立之際，未嘗預謀。
units.en: At every coup and enthronement thereafter he kept clear of the plotting.
units.literal: Later when occasions of deposition and enthronement came, he never participated in plotting.

units.zh: 景文二帝以孚屬尊，不敢逼。
units.en: Sima Shi and Sima Zhao honored his seniority and never leaned on him.
units.literal: Emperors Jing and Wen, because Fu's standing was venerable, did not dare coerce him.

units.zh: 後進封長樂公。
units.en: He was later advanced to duke of Changle.
units.literal: Later he was advanced and enfeoffed as duke of Changle.

units.zh: 及武帝受禪，陳留王就金墉城，孚拜辭，執王手，流涕歔欷，不能自勝。
units.en: When Sima Yan took the throne the Wei emperor withdrew to Jinyong; Fu clasped his hand in farewell and wept uncontrollably.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication, the king of Chenliu went to Jinyong Fortress; Fu took leave of him, grasped the king's hand, wept and sobbed, and could not overcome himself.

units.zh: 曰：「臣死之日，固大魏之純臣也。」
units.en: He said, 'On the day I die I shall indeed be a pure minister of Great Wei.'
units.literal: He said, 'On the day I die I shall indeed be a pure minister of Great Wei.'

units.zh: 詔曰：「太傅勳德弘茂，朕所瞻仰，以光導弘訓，鎮靜宇內，願奉以不臣之禮。
units.en: An edict said, 'The Grand Mentor's merit and virtue are vast and flourishing—what I look up to; by him brilliance guides instruction and calms the realm within the four seas—I wish to accord him rites that need not treat him as subject.
units.literal: An edict said, 'The Grand Mentor's merit and virtue are vast and flourishing—what I look up to; by him brilliance guides instruction and calms the realm within the four seas—I wish to accord him rites that need not treat him as subject.

units.zh: 其封為安平王，邑四萬戶。
units.en: Enfeoff him as prince of Anping with forty thousand households.
units.literal: Enfeoff him as prince of Anping with forty thousand households.

units.zh: 進拜太宰、持節、都督中外諸軍事。」
units.en: Advance him to Grand Preceptor, bearer of credentials, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs inside and outside."
units.literal: Advance him to Grand Preceptor, bearer of credentials, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs inside and outside."

units.zh: 有司奏，諸王未之國者，所置官屬，權未有備。
units.en: Bureaus noted princes remaining at capital lacked complete households.
units.literal: The relevant offices memorialized that for princes not yet gone to their fiefs the assigned staffs still lacked full appointments.

units.zh: 帝以孚明德屬尊，當宣化樹教，為群後作則，遂備置官屬焉。
units.en: The emperor ruled Fu's moral weight required a full household to model conduct for other royal uncles.
units.literal: The emperor held that Fu's bright virtue and eminent standing ought to propagate transformation and establish instruction and serve as model for the host of kings; thereupon full staffs were completely appointed.

units.zh: 又以孚內有親戚，外有交遊，惠下之費，而經用不豐，奉絹二千匹。
units.en: Considering his kin, his hospitality, and modest stipend, the throne added two thousand rolls of silk.
units.literal: Also because Fu had relatives within and friends without and expenses in showing kindness to subordinates yet regular income was not abundant, he was granted two thousand bolts of tribute silk.

units.zh: 及元會，詔孚輿車上殿，帝於阼階迎拜。
units.en: At court assembly his cart mounted the hall while Sima Yan bowed him in from the eastern stair.
units.literal: At the New Year audience an edict ordered Fu's carriage onto the hall while the emperor greeted him with a bow on the eastern steps.

units.zh: 既坐，帝親奉觴上壽，如家人禮。
units.en: Seated, the emperor toasted him with familial warmth.
units.literal: Once seated the emperor personally raised a cup and toasted him with family courtesy.

units.zh: 帝每拜，孚跪而止之。
units.en: Each time Sima Yan bowed, Fu dropped to his knees to forbid it.
units.literal: Whenever the emperor bowed, Fu knelt to stop him.

units.zh: 又給以雲母輦、青蓋車。
units.en: He received a mica litter and an azure parasol carriage.
units.literal: He was also granted a mica-canopied carriage and a blue-canopied coach.

units.zh: 孚雖見尊寵，不以為榮，常有憂色。
units.en: Yet privilege brought him no joy—his face stayed shadowed with worry.
units.literal: Though Fu saw honor and favor he did not regard it as glory and often wore a troubled expression.

units.zh: 臨終，遺令曰：「有魏貞士河內溫縣司馬孚，字叔達，不伊不周，不夷不惠，立身行道，終始若一，當以素棺單槨，斂以時服。」
units.en: At his deathbed his testament said, 'There was a Wei loyalist of Henei Wen county, Sima Fu, courtesy Shuda—not acting Yi Yin or the Duke of Zhou, neither withdrawing like Boyi nor compromising like Liuxiahui—who established himself and walked the Way from first to last as one; bury me in an unvarnished coffin with a single-layer outer shell and dress me in timely ordinary clothes.'
units.literal: At his deathbed his testament said, 'There was a Wei loyalist of Henei Wen county, Sima Fu, courtesy Shuda—not acting Yi Yin or the Duke of Zhou, neither withdrawing like Boyi nor compromising like Liuxiahui—who established himself and walked the Way from first to last as one; bury me in an unvarnished coffin with a single-layer outer shell and dress me in timely ordinary clothes.'

units.zh: 泰始八年薨，時年九十三。
units.en: He died in the eighth year of Taishi at ninety-three.
units.literal: He died in the eighth year of Taishi at ninety-three.

units.zh: 帝於太極東堂舉哀三日。
units.en: Emperor Wu mourned three days in Taiji's east hall.
units.literal: The emperor observed mourning three days in the eastern hall of Taiji Palace.

units.zh: 詔曰：「王勳德超世，尊寵無二，期頤在位，朕之所倚。
units.en: An edict said, 'The prince's merit and virtue surpass the age; honor and favor were without peer; he dwelt in office at a hundred years—what I relied upon.
units.literal: An edict said, 'The prince's merit and virtue surpass the age; honor and favor were without peer; he dwelt in office at a hundred years—what I relied upon.

units.zh: 庶永百齡，諮仰訓導，奄忽殂隕，哀慕感切。
units.en: I hoped he would last forever to consult and look up to his instruction—suddenly he has fallen and passed away; grief and longing cut deep.
units.literal: I hoped he would last forever to consult and look up to his instruction—suddenly he has fallen and passed away; grief and longing cut deep.

units.zh: 其以東園溫明秘器、朝服一具、衣一襲、緋練百匹、絹布各五百匹、錢百萬，穀千斛以供喪事。
units.en: Let there be supplied for the funeral the eastern park warming coffin and secret fittings, one set of court dress, one suit of clothes, one hundred bolts of crimson silk, five hundred bolts each of silk and cloth, a million cash, and a thousand hu of grain.
units.literal: Let there be supplied for the funeral the eastern park warming coffin and secret fittings, one set of court dress, one suit of clothes, one hundred bolts of crimson silk, five hundred bolts each of silk and cloth, a million cash, and a thousand hu of grain.

units.zh: 諸所施行，皆依漢東平獻王蒼故事。」
units.en: All measures implemented shall follow the precedent of Han Prince Xian of Dongping, Liu Cang."
units.literal: All measures implemented shall follow the precedent of Han Prince Xian of Dongping, Liu Cang."

units.zh: 其家遵孚遺旨，所給器物，一不施用。
units.en: The clan honored his will and refused every gifted token.
units.literal: His family obeyed Fu's testamentary instructions; not one of the supplied implements was used.

units.zh: 帝再臨喪，親拜盡哀。
units.en: Sima Yan returned twice to bow in deepest sorrow.
units.literal: The emperor twice attended the mourning and personally bowed in full grief.

units.zh: 及葬，又幸都亭，望柩而拜，哀動左右。
units.en: At interment he halted at the post station, bowed toward the catafalque, and moved every witness.
units.literal: When it came to burial he also went to the courier station, gazed toward the bier and bowed, moving those around him to grief.

units.zh: 給鑾輅輕車，介士武賁百人，吉凶導從二千餘人，前後鼓吹，配饗太廟。
units.en: The cortège drew imperial hearses, a hundred household guards, two thousand ushers, full musical escort, and enshrinement beside the royal ancestors.
units.literal: There were provided imperial escort carriages and light wagons, one hundred armored guards and palace runners, over two thousand attendants for auspicious and inauspicious processions, front and rear trumpets and drums, and joint sacrifice in the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 九子：邕、望、輔、翼、晃、瑰、珪、衡、景。
units.en: He had nine sons named Yong, Wang, Fu, Yi, Huang, Gui, Gui, Heng, and Jing—the fifth and sixth homophonous but written with different graphs.
units.literal: Nine sons: Yong, Wang, Fu, Yi, Huang, Gui (lapis), Gui (jade tablet), Heng, Jing.

units.zh: 子邕
units.en: The heir, Yong.
units.literal: Zi Yong.

units.zh: =邕字子魁。
units.en: Sima Yong bore the courtesy name Zikui.
units.literal: Yong styled Zikui (the leading equals sign is a table marker in the source).

units.zh: 初為世子，拜步兵校尉、侍中。
units.en: While heir he served as colonel of infantry and palace attendant.
units.literal: At first he was heir apparent and was appointed Colonel of Infantry and palace attendant.

units.zh: 先孚卒，追贈輔國將軍，諡曰貞。
units.en: He predeceased Sima Fu and was posthumously named assistant general who supports the state, with the epithet Zhen.
units.literal: He died before Fu; posthumously he was invested Assistant-General Who Supports the State with posthumous title Zhen.

units.zh: 邕子崇為世孫，又早夭，
units.en: His son Chong was named next-generation heir but died in childhood.
units.literal: Yong's son Chong was heir grandson and also died young.

units.zh: 泰始九年，立崇弟平陽亭侯隆為安平王。
units.en: In Taishi year nine, the throne invested Chong's younger brother Long, Marquis of Pingyang Precinct, as Prince of Anping.
units.literal: In Taishi year nine, the throne invested Chong's younger brother Long, Marquis of Pingyang Precinct, as Prince of Anping.

units.zh: 立四年，咸寧二年薨，諡曰穆，無子，國絕。
units.en: After four years, he died in Xianning year two with posthumous epithet Mu; without heirs, the principality was extinguished.
units.literal: After four years, he died in Xianning year two with posthumous epithet Mu; without heirs, the principality was extinguished.

units.zh: 邕弟義陽成王望
units.en: Yong's brother Sima Wang, Prince Cheng of Yiyang.
units.literal: Yong's younger brother Wang, Prince Cheng of Yiyang

units.zh: =義陽成王望，字子初，出繼伯父朗，寬厚有父風。
units.en: Sima Wang, Prince Cheng of Yiyang, styled Zichu, was adopted into uncle Sima Lang's line—open-handed and steady like his father.
units.literal: Prince Cheng of Yiyang, Wang, courtesy Zichu, went out to succeed uncle Lang; he was generous and mild and had his father's manner.

units.zh: 仕郡上計吏，舉孝廉，辟司徒掾，曆平陽太守、洛陽典農中郎將。
units.en: He rose from commandery accountant through filial-incorrupt recommendation and ministerial aide to Pingyang governor and Luoyang agrarian colonel.
units.literal: He served the commandery as accounts clerk, was recommended Filial and Incorrupt, was summoned as aide to the Minister of Education, and successively held governor of Pingyang and Agrarian Commandant of Luoyang.

units.zh: 從宣帝討王淩，以功封永安亭侯。
units.en: Campaigning with Sima Yi against Wang Ling earned him the Yong'an ting marquisate.
units.literal: He followed Emperor Xuan to punish Wang Ling and by merit was enfeoffed Marquis of Yong'an precinct.

units.zh: 遷護軍將軍，改封安樂鄉侯，加散騎常侍。
units.en: Promoted general who guards the army, he exchanged his fief for Anle township and received supernumerary cavalry attendant rank.
units.literal: He was promoted General Who Guards the Army, changed enfeoffment to Marquis of Anle village, and added irregular cavalry attendant.

units.zh: 時魏高貴鄉公好才愛士，望與裴秀、王沈、鍾會並見親待，數侍宴筵。
units.en: Cao Mao cultivated writers and thinkers; Wang joined Pei Xiu, Wang Chen, and Zhong Hui in the emperor's intimate circle at countless banquets.
units.literal: At that time Wei Duke of Gaoguixiang loved talent and cherished scholars; Wang together with Pei Xiu, Wang Chen, and Zhong Hui alike saw intimate favor and repeatedly attended banquets.

units.zh: 公性急，秀等居內職，急有召便至。
units.en: The sovereign's temper ran hot; men like Pei Xiu, holding palace posts, could answer an urgent summons immediately.
units.literal: The duke was impatient by nature; Xiu and others held inner posts and when urgently summoned arrived at once.

units.zh: 以望外官，特給追鋒車一乘，武賁五人。
units.en: As an outsider he was granted a rapid courier cart and five household guards.
units.literal: Because Wang was an outer official, specially there was given one swift-response carriage and five palace runners.

units.zh: 時景文相繼輔政，未嘗朝覲，權歸晉室。
units.en: Sima Shi and Sima Zhao ruled behind the curtain without formal audiences—effective authority already rested with the future Jin house.
units.literal: At that time Jing and Wen succeeded each other as regents and never held court audience; power returned to the Jin house.

units.zh: 望雖見寵待，每不自安，由是求出，為征西將軍、持節、都督雍涼二州諸軍事。
units.en: Royal favor could not settle him; he won a western command as conquering-general with credentials over Yong and Liang.
units.literal: Though Wang saw favor and treatment, often he was not at ease; on this account he sought to go out and became General Who Conquers the West, bearer of credentials, and supervisor of all military affairs of Yong and Liang provinces.

units.zh: 在任八年，威化明肅。
units.en: Across eight years his governance ran lucid and austere.
units.literal: In office eight years, his awe-inspiring transformation was bright and stern.

units.zh: 先是蜀將薑維屢寇關中，及望至，廣設方略，維不得為寇，關中賴之。
units.en: After Jiang Wei's repeated strikes on Guanzhong, Wang's strategy stopped further incursions and steadied the northwest.
units.literal: Earlier Shu general Jiang Wei repeatedly raided Guanzhong; when Wang arrived he broadly laid plans and measures so Wei could not raid; Guanzhong relied on him.

units.zh: 進封順陽侯。
units.en: His fief rose to marquis of Shunyang.
units.literal: He was advanced and enfeoffed Marquis of Shunyang.

units.zh: 徵拜衛將軍，領中領軍，典禁兵。
units.en: Recalled as metropolitan guard, he headed the central army and commanded palace soldiers.
units.literal: He was summoned and appointed General Who Guards the Metropolis, concurrently Central Army Supervisor, in charge of palace troops.

units.zh: 尋加驃騎將軍、開府。
units.en: He soon added champion-general rank with an independent staff.
units.literal: Soon he was additionally appointed Champion General and granted independent headquarters.

units.zh: 頃之，代何曾為司徒。
units.en: Shortly afterward he succeeded He Zeng as minister of education.
units.literal: Before long he replaced He Zeng as Minister of Education.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封義陽王，邑萬戶，給兵二千人，
units.en: When Sima Yan took the throne Wang became prince of Yiyang at ten thousand households with a guard allotment of two thousand.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Yiyang with ten thousand households and two thousand troops granted.

units.zh: 泰始三年，詔曰：「夫尚賢庸勳，尊宗茂親，所以體國經化，式是百辟也。
units.en: In the third year of Taishi, an edict said, 'To esteem the worthy and employ the meritorious, to honor the clan and enrich kin—that is how one embodies the state and regulates transformation and serves as model for the hundred ministers.
units.literal: In the third year of Taishi, an edict said, 'To esteem the worthy and employ the meritorious, to honor the clan and enrich kin—that is how one embodies the state and regulates transformation and serves as model for the hundred ministers.

units.zh: 且台司之重，存乎天官，故周建六職，政典為首。
units.en: Moreover the weight of the terrace ministers rests in Heaven's offices; therefore Zhou established six duties and governance statutes came first.
units.literal: Moreover the weight of the terrace ministers rests in Heaven's offices; therefore Zhou established six duties and governance statutes came first.

units.zh: 司徒、中領軍，以明德近屬，世濟其美；
units.en: Minister of Education and Central Army Supervisor—by bright virtue as close kin across generations perfect their excellence;
units.literal: Minister of Education and Central Army Supervisor—by bright virtue as close kin across generations perfect their excellence;

units.zh: 祖考創業，翼佐大命，出典方任，入贊朝政，文德既著，武功宣暢。
units.en: Grandfather and father founded enterprise, assisted the great mandate, went out to administer regional duty, entered to assist court governance; civil virtue was already manifest, martial merit widely displayed.
units.literal: Grandfather and father founded enterprise, assisted the great mandate, went out to administer regional duty, entered to assist court governance; civil virtue was already manifest, martial merit widely displayed.

units.zh: 逮朕嗣位，弼道惟明，宜登上司，兼統軍戎，內輔帝室，外隆威重，其進位太尉，中領軍如故。
units.en: Down to Our succeeding the throne you have aided the Way with clarity; fittingly mount the high minister and concurrently command the army—within assist the imperial house, without raise mighty awe; We advance your rank to Grand Commandant; Central Army Supervisor as before.
units.literal: Down to Our succeeding the throne you have aided the Way with clarity; fittingly mount the high minister and concurrently command the army—within assist the imperial house, without raise mighty awe; We advance your rank to Grand Commandant; Central Army Supervisor as before.

units.zh: 置太尉軍司一人，參軍事六人，騎司馬五人。
units.en: Establish one army aide to the Grand Commandant, six military staff advisers, five cavalry majors.
units.literal: Establish one army aide to the Grand Commandant, six military staff advisers, five cavalry majors.

units.zh: 又增置官騎十人，並前三十，假羽葆鼓吹。」
units.en: Also additionally establish ten official mounted escorts—together with the former thirty—and confer feather-canopy band and drum.'
units.literal: Also additionally establish ten official mounted escorts—together with the former thirty—and confer feather-canopy band and drum.'

units.zh: 吳將施績寇江夏，邊境騷動。
units.en: Wu general Shi Ji's strike on Jiangxia threw the frontier into alarm.
units.literal: Wu general Shi Ji raided Jiangxia and the border was disturbed.

units.zh: 以望統中軍步騎二萬，出屯龍陂，為二方重鎮，假節，加大都督諸軍事。
units.en: Wang led twenty thousand central troops to Longpi as the brace between two theaters, credentials in hand as grand commander.
units.literal: Wang was ordered to command twenty thousand infantry and cavalry of the central army, go out and encamp at Longpi as heavy garrison for two fronts, given credentials, and additionally promoted grand commander of all military affairs.

units.zh: 會荊州刺史胡烈距績，破之，望乃班師。
units.en: When Jing inspector Hu Lie routed Shi Ji, Wang stood down his army.
units.literal: It happened that Inspector of Jing Province Hu Lie resisted Ji and defeated him; thereupon Wang withdrew the army.

units.zh: 俄而吳將丁奉寇芍陂，望又率諸軍以赴之，未至而奉退。
units.en: Ding Feng's raid on Quepi drew Wang east again, though the enemy slipped away before he arrived.
units.literal: Soon Wu general Ding Feng raided Quepi; Wang again led the various armies to hurry there; before he arrived Feng withdrew.

units.zh: 拜大司馬。
units.en: He received appointment as grand marshal.
units.literal: He was appointed Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 孫皓率眾向壽春，詔望統中軍二萬，騎三千，據淮北。
units.en: Sun Hao's thrust toward Shouchun sent Wang to the north bank of the Huai with twenty thousand foot and three thousand horse.
units.literal: Sun Hao led a host toward Shouchun; an edict ordered Wang to command twenty thousand central troops and three thousand cavalry and hold north of the Huai.

units.zh: 皓退，軍罷。
units.en: Sun Hao withdrew and the mobilization ended.
units.literal: Hao withdrew and the army was disbanded.

units.zh: 泰始七年薨，時年六十七，賻贈有加，望性儉吝而好聚斂，身亡之後，金帛盈溢，以此獲譏。
units.en: In the seventh year of Taishi, he died at sixty-seven amid lavish obsequies yet earned ridicule for having hoarded treasure despite a miserly reputation.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Taishi, he died at age sixty-seven; funeral gifts were generous in addition; Wang's nature was frugal and stingy yet fond of amassing; after his death gold and silk overflowed; on this account he incurred ridicule.

units.zh: 四子：弈、洪、整、楙。
units.en: Four sons survived him: Yi, Hong, Zheng, and Mao.
units.literal: Four sons: Yi, Hong, Zheng, Mao.

units.zh: 弈至黃門郎，先望卒。
units.en: Yi rose to yellow-gate gentleman but died before his father.
units.literal: Yi reached Yellow Gate Gentleman and died before Wang.

units.zh: 整亦早亡。
units.en: Zheng likewise died young.
units.literal: Zheng also died young.

units.zh: 以弈子奇襲爵。
units.en: The title passed to Yi's son Qi.
units.literal: By Yi's son Qi the noble rank was inherited.

units.zh: 奇亦好畜聚，不知紀極，遣三部使到交廣商貨，為有司所奏，太康九年，詔貶為三縱亭侯。
units.en: Qi also delighted in hoarding wealth without limit, sending three divisions of agents to trade in Jiao and Guang; after officials memorialized against him, an edict in Taikang year nine demoted him to Marquis of Sanzong Precinct.
units.literal: Qi also delighted in hoarding wealth without limit, sending three divisions of agents to trade in Jiao and Guang; after officials memorialized against him, an edict in Taikang year nine demoted him to Marquis of Sanzong Precinct.

units.zh: 更以章武王威為望嗣。
units.en: The throne then named Sima Wei of Zhangwu as Wang's heir.
units.literal: Next Prince Wei of Zhangwu was made Wang's successor.

units.zh: 後威誅，復立奇為棘陽王以嗣望。
units.en: After Wei's execution Qi was restored as Prince of Jiyang to continue Wang's line.
units.literal: Later when Wei was executed, Qi was again established as Prince of Jiyang to succeed Wang.

units.zh: 望子河間平王洪
units.en: Wang's son Sima Hong, Prince Ping of Hejian.
units.literal: Wang's son Hong, Prince Ping of Hejian

units.zh: 河間平王洪，字孔業，出繼叔父昌武亭侯遺。
units.en: Sima Hong, Prince Ping of Hejian, styled Kongye, was adopted into uncle Yi's Changwu ting line.
units.literal: Prince Ping of Hejian, Hong, courtesy Kongye, went out to succeed uncle Marquis of Changwu precinct Yi.

units.zh: 仕魏，歷位典農中郎將、原武太守，封襄賁男。
units.en: Under Wei he served as agrarian colonel, Yuanwu governor, and baron of Xiangben.
units.literal: Serving Wei he successively held Agrarian Commandant, governor of Yuanwu, and was enfeoffed Baron of Xiangben.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封河間王。
units.en: When Sima Yan took the throne Hong became prince of Hejian.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Hejian.

units.zh: 立十二年，咸寧二年薨。
units.en: After twelve years in the position, he died in Xianning year two.
units.literal: After twelve years in the position, he died in Xianning year two.

units.zh: 二子：威、混。
units.en: He left two sons, Wei and Hun.
units.literal: Two sons: Wei and Hun.

units.zh: 威嗣，徙封章武。
units.en: Wei inherited and moved the fief to Zhangwu.
units.literal: Wei succeeded and was transferred enfeoffment to Zhangwu.

units.zh: 其後威既繼義陽王望，更立混為洪嗣。
units.en: Once Wei continued Sima Wang's Yiyang title, Hun was designated Hong's heir.
units.literal: Later when Wei had succeeded Prince of Yiyang Wang, Hun was further established as Hong's successor.

units.zh: 混歷位散常侍，薨。
units.en: Hun served as supernumerary cavalry attendant and died.
units.literal: Hun successively held irregular attendant posts and died.

units.zh: 及洛陽陷，混諸子皆沒于胡。
units.en: Luoyang's fall sent Hun's sons into Hu captivity.
units.literal: When Luoyang fell, Hun's various sons all fell captive among the Hu.

units.zh: 而小子滔初嗣新蔡王確，亦與其兄俱沒。
units.en: Youngest son Tao—even after succeeding Prince Que of Xincai—was seized alongside his brothers.
units.literal: Yet the youngest son Tao had first succeeded Prince of Xincai Que and together with his elder brothers was also taken captive.

units.zh: 後得南還，與新蔡太妃不協。
units.en: After fleeing south he quarreled with his adoptive mother the Xincai dowager.
units.literal: Later obtaining southward return he was not harmonious with the Dowager Princess of Xincai.

units.zh: 太興二年上疏，以兄弟並沒在遼東，章武國絕，宜還所生。
units.en: In 319 he petitioned to return to his birth line while brothers remained in Liaodong and Zhangwu lacked heirs.
units.literal: In the second year of Taixing he submitted a memorial stating that brothers alike were held captive in Liaodong, the Zhangwu state was cut off, and he ought to return to his birth family.

units.zh: 太妃訟之，事下太常。
units.en: The dowager sued; the court referred the case to the ministry of rites.
units.literal: The dowager princess sued him; the matter went down to the Minister of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 太常賀循議：「章武、新蔡俱承一國不絕之統，義不得替其本宗而先後傍親。
units.en: Minister He Xun argued: 'Zhangwu and Xincai alike inherit an unbroken mandate of one state; by principle one may not supplant one's root lineage for collateral kin out of order.
units.literal: Minister He Xun argued: 'Zhangwu and Xincai alike inherit an unbroken mandate of one state; by principle one may not supplant one's root lineage for collateral kin out of order.

units.zh: 按滔既已被命為人後矣，必須無復兄弟，本國永絕，然後得還所生。
units.en: Accordingly Tao having already received appointment as someone's heir must wait until he certainly has no brothers left and his original state is forever cut off—only then may he return to those who bore him.
units.literal: Accordingly Tao having already received appointment as someone's heir must wait until he certainly has no brothers left and his original state is forever cut off—only then may he return to those who bore him.

units.zh: 今兄弟在遠，不得言無，道里雖阻，復非絕域。
units.en: Now brothers are distant—one cannot say there are none; though roads are blocked they are again not unreachable wastes.
units.literal: Now brothers are distant—one cannot say there are none; though roads are blocked they are again not unreachable wastes.

units.zh: 且鮮卑恭命，信使不絕。
units.en: Moreover the Xianbei defer to commands; envoys do not cease.
units.literal: Moreover the Xianbei defer to commands; envoys do not cease.

units.zh: 自宜詔下遼東，依劉群、盧諶等例，發遣令還，繼嗣本封。
units.en: Naturally it is fitting to issue edicts down to Liaodong following the precedent of Liu Qun, Lu Chen, and others, dispatch and order them to return and succeed their root enfeoffments.
units.literal: Naturally it is fitting to issue edicts down to Liaodong following the precedent of Liu Qun, Lu Chen, and others, dispatch and order them to return and succeed their root enfeoffments.

units.zh: 謂滔今未得便委離所後也。」
units.en: This means Tao now cannot simply abandon the house he succeeded."
units.literal: This means Tao now cannot simply abandon the house he succeeded."

units.zh: 元帝詔曰：「滔雖出養，自有所生母。
units.en: Emperor Yuan's edict said, 'Though Tao went out to be raised he naturally has a birth mother.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan's edict said, 'Though Tao went out to be raised he naturally has a birth mother.

units.zh: 新蔡太妃相待甚薄，滔執意如此。
units.en: The Dowager Princess of Xincai treated him very coldly; Tao held to his intent in this way.
units.literal: The Dowager Princess of Xincai treated him very coldly; Tao held to his intent in this way.

units.zh: 如其不聽，終當紛紜，更為不可。
units.en: If she does not heed him in the end there will be wrangling and again it will be impossible.
units.literal: If she does not heed him in the end there will be wrangling and again it will be impossible.

units.zh: 今便順其所執，還襲章武。」
units.en: Now let Us comply with what he insists on and let him return and inherit Zhangwu."
units.literal: Now let Us comply with what he insists on and let him return and inherit Zhangwu."

units.zh: 滔歷位散騎常侍，薨，子休嗣。
units.en: Tao rose to supernumerary cavalry attendant, died, and Xiu inherited.
units.literal: Tao successively held irregular cavalry attendant and died; son Xiu succeeded.

units.zh: 休與彭城王雄俱奔蘇峻。
units.en: Xiu fled with Prince Xiong of Pengcheng into Su Jun's camp.
units.literal: Xiu together with Prince Xiong of Pengcheng both fled to Su Jun.

units.zh: 峻平，休已戰死。
units.en: When Su Jun fell Xiu was already slain on the field.
units.literal: When Jun was pacified Xiu had already died in battle.

units.zh: 弟珍年八歲，以小弗坐。
units.en: Eight-year-old Zhen escaped punishment as a minor.
units.literal: Younger brother Zhen was eight years old and because young was not punished.

units.zh: 咸和六年襲爵，位至大宗正。
units.en: In the sixth year of Xianhe, he succeeded to the title and rose to director of the imperial clan.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Xianhe, he inherited the noble rank and reached Grand Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 薨，無嗣，河間王欽以子範之繼，位至遊擊將軍。
units.en: He died without an heir, and Prince Qin of Hejian designated his son Fanzhi to succeed him. Fanzhi rose to General of Roving Attack.
units.literal: He died without heir; Prince Qin of Hejian gave son Fanzhi to succeed; Fanzhi reached General Who Roams and Strikes.

units.zh: 薨，子秀嗣，
units.en: He died; Xiu inherited the title.
units.literal: He died; son Xiu succeeded.

units.zh: 義熙元年，為桂陽太守。
units.en: In the first year of Yixi, Xiu governed Guiyang commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Yixi, he became governor of Guiyang.

units.zh: 秀妻桓振之妹，振作逆，秀不自安，謀反，伏誅，國除。
units.en: Married to Huan Zhen's sister, Xiu panicked when Zhen rebelled, plotted in turn, and was executed—the principality struck from the rolls.
units.literal: Xiu's wife was Huan Zhen's younger sister; when Zhen rebelled Xiu was uneasy and plotted rebellion; he was executed by secret decree and the state was abolished.

units.zh: 洪子威
units.en: Hong's son Sima Wei.
units.literal: Hong zi Wei.

units.zh: 威字景曜，初嗣洪，
units.en: Sima Wei, styled Jingyao, first inherited Hong.
units.literal: Wei courtesy Jingyao at first succeeded Hong.

units.zh: 咸寧三年，徙封章武。
units.en: In Xianning year three, his fief was transferred to Zhangwu.
units.literal: In Xianning year three, his fief was transferred to Zhangwu.

units.zh: 太康九年，嗣義陽王望。
units.en: In Taikang year nine, he continued Sima Wang's Yiyang princedom.
units.literal: In Taikang year nine, he continued Sima Wang's Yiyang princedom.

units.zh: 威凶暴無操行，諂附趙王倫。
units.en: Savage and unscrupulous, he hitched himself to Sima Lun.
units.literal: Wei was fierce and violent without moral conduct and flattered and attached himself to Prince Zhao Lun.

units.zh: 元康末，為散騎常侍，倫將篡，使威與黃門郎駱休逼帝奪璽綬，倫以威為中書令。
units.en: Late in Yuankang he helped Sima Lun wrench the seal from Emperor Hui alongside Luo Xiu, then took the palace secretariat.
units.literal: At the end of Yuankang he was irregular cavalry attendant; when Lun was about to usurp he sent Wei together with Yellow Gate Gentleman Luo Xiu to coerce the emperor and seize the seal cords; Lun appointed Wei Palace Secretariat Director.

units.zh: 倫敗，惠帝反正，曰：「阿皮捩吾指，奪吾璽綬，不可不殺。」
units.en: When Lun was defeated Emperor Hui resumed right rule and said, 'Api twisted my fingers and seized my seal cords—cannot fail to kill him.'
units.literal: When Lun was defeated Emperor Hui resumed right rule and said, 'Api twisted my fingers and seized my seal cords—cannot fail to kill him.'

units.zh: 阿皮，威小字也。
units.en: Api' was Wei's infant name.
units.literal: Api was Wei's childhood name.

units.zh: 於是誅威。
units.en: Wei was put to death.
units.literal: Thereupon Wei was executed.

units.zh: 洪弟隨穆王整
units.en: Hong's brother Sima Zheng, Prince Mu of Sui.
units.literal: Hong's younger brother Zheng, Prince Mu of Sui

units.zh: 隨穆王整，兄弈卒，以整為世子。
units.en: When Yi died Zheng became heir of the Yiyang house.
units.literal: Prince Mu of Sui, Zheng—when elder brother Yi died Zheng was made heir apparent.

units.zh: 曆南中郎將，封清泉侯，先父望薨，追贈冠軍將軍。
units.en: He commanded southern gentlemen and held Qingquan marquis but predeceased Sima Wang; upon Wang's death the court posthumously named him Champion General.
units.literal: He successively held General of the Southern Gentlemen, was enfeoffed Marquis of Qingquan; he died before his father Wang; when Wang died he was posthumously invested Champion General.

units.zh: 武帝以義陽國一縣追封為隨縣王。
units.en: Emperor Wu carved out Sui county from Yiyang for his posthumous princedom.
units.literal: Emperor Wu used one county of the Yiyang state to posthumously enfeoff him as Prince of Sui county.

units.zh: 子邁嗣。
units.en: Mai succeeded him.
units.literal: Son Mai succeeded.

units.zh: 太康九年，以義陽之平林益邁為隨郡王。
units.en: In 288 Yiyang's Pinglin canton enlarged Mai's domain to prince of Sui commandery.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Taikang Pinglin of Yiyang was added to enlarge Mai as Prince of Sui commandery.

units.zh: 整弟竟陵王楙
units.en: Zheng's brother Sima Mao, prince of Jingling.
units.literal: Zheng's younger brother Mao, Prince of Jingling

units.zh: 竟陵王楙，字孔偉，初封樂陵亭侯，起家參相國軍事。
units.en: Sima Mao, styled Kongwei, began as marquis of Leling ting on the prince's military staff.
units.literal: Prince of Jingling Mao, courtesy Kongwei, at first was enfeoffed Marquis of Leling precinct and began office as participant in princely-state military affairs.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封東平王，邑三千九十七戶。
units.en: When Sima Yan took the throne Mao became prince of Dongping at 3,097 households.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Dongping with three thousand ninety-seven households.

units.zh: 入為散騎常侍、尚書。
units.en: He transferred to the capital as supernumerary cavalry attendant and ministry counselor.
units.literal: He entered court as irregular cavalry attendant and minister.

units.zh: 楙善諂諛，曲事楊駿。
units.en: Sima Mao excelled at sycophancy and curried favor with Yang Jun.
units.literal: Mao was skilled at flattery and fawning and bent his service to Yang Jun.

units.zh: 及駿誅，依法當死，東安公繇與楙善，故得不坐。
units.en: Jun's fall should have cost Mao his life, yet Sima You's friendship shielded him.
units.literal: When Jun was executed, by law Mao ought to have died, but Duke of Dongan You was friendly with Mao, so he avoided punishment.

units.zh: 尋遷大鴻臚，加侍中。
units.en: He soon rose to grand herald with supernumerary palace attendant rank.
units.literal: Soon he was promoted Grand Herald and added palace attendant.

units.zh: 繇欲擅朝政，與汝南王亮不平。
units.en: Sima You grasped for centralized power and clashed with Prince Liang of Runan.
units.literal: You wished to monopolize court government and was at odds with Prince Liang of Runan.

units.zh: 帝托以繇討駿顧望，免繇、楙等官，遣楙就國。
units.en: Emperor Hui blamed Sima You for half-hearted action against Jun, cashiered both men, and banished Mao to his domain.
units.literal: The emperor on the pretext that You hesitated in attacking Jun removed You and Mao from office and sent Mao to his fief.

units.zh: 楙殖財貨，奢僭逾制。
units.en: He hoarded treasure and flouted sumptuary law with pretensions beyond his rank.
units.literal: Mao amassed wealth and goods; extravagance and usurpation of ritual exceeded regulations.

units.zh: 趙王倫篡位，召還。
units.en: Sima Lun's coup brought Mao back to court.
units.literal: When Prince Zhao Lun usurped the throne he recalled Mao.

units.zh: 及義兵起，倫以楙為衛將軍、都督諸軍事。
units.en: Once loyalist armies rose Lun named Mao metropolitan guard and overall commander.
units.literal: When the righteous host rose, Lun appointed Mao General Who Guards the Metropolis and supervisor of all military affairs.

units.zh: 倫敗，楙免官。
units.en: Lun's fall stripped Mao of his posts.
units.literal: When Lun was defeated Mao was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 齊王冏輔政，繇復為僕射，舉楙為平東將軍、都督徐州諸軍事，鎮下邳。
units.en: Under Sima Jiong's regency Sima You returned as vice director and nominated Mao as pacifier-general for Xu based at Xiapi.
units.literal: When Prince of Qi Jiong assisted government You again became vice director and recommended Mao as General Who Pacifies the East and supervisor of Xu military affairs, stationed at Xiapi.

units.zh: 成都王穎輔政，進楙為衛將軍。
units.en: Sima Ying's turn at power promoted Mao to metropolitan guard.
units.literal: When Prince of Chengdu Ying assisted government Mao was advanced to General Who Guards the Metropolis.

units.zh: 會惠帝北征，即以楙為車騎將軍，都督如故，使率眾赴鄴。
units.en: The northern expedition made Mao chariot-and-cavalry general at Ye with unchanged theater command.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui campaigned north Mao was at once made chariot-and-cavalry general with supervisory duties unchanged and ordered to lead troops toward Ye.

units.zh: 蕩陰之役，東海王越奔於下邳，楙不納，越乃還國。
units.en: After Dangyin Sima Yue sought refuge at Xiapi; Mao shut the gates and sent him home.
units.literal: In the Dangyin fighting Prince of Donghai Yue fled to Xiapi; Mao refused him entry, so Yue returned to his state.

units.zh: 帝既西幸，越總兵謀迎大駕，楙甚懼。
units.en: After Emperor Hui had gone west, Sima Yue gathered troops and planned to welcome back the imperial carriage; Mao was greatly afraid.
units.literal: Once the emperor had fled west Yue gathered troops planning to welcome the imperial carriage; Mao was greatly afraid.

units.zh: 長史王修說曰：「東海宗室重望，今將興義，公宜舉徐州以授之，此克讓之美也。」
units.en: Chief Clerk Wang Xiu advised saying, 'Prince of Donghai carries heavy prestige among the imperial clan; now he will raise righteous arms—you ought to yield Xu Province to him; this is the beauty of yielding precedence.'
units.literal: Chief Clerk Wang Xiu advised saying, 'Prince of Donghai carries heavy prestige among the imperial clan; now he will raise righteous arms—you ought to yield Xu Province to him; this is the beauty of yielding precedence.'

units.zh: 楙從之，乃自承制都督兗州刺史、車騎將軍，表于天子。
units.en: Mao complied, seized Yan under emergency orders as chariot-and-cavalry chief, and reported to the throne.
units.literal: Mao followed this; thereupon on his own authority under emergency regulations he acted as supervisor of Yan Province and chariot-and-cavalry general and memorialized the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 時帝在長安，遣使者劉虔即拜焉。
units.en: At Chang'an the court sent Liu Qian to seal the arrangement.
units.literal: At that time the emperor was at Chang'an and dispatched envoy Liu Qian to confirm the appointment on the spot.

units.zh: 楙慮兗州刺史苟晞不避己，乃給虔兵，使稱詔誅晞。
units.en: Fearing Gou Xi, Mao armed Liu Qian with a forged warrant for Xi's death.
units.literal: Mao feared Yan Inspector Gou Xi would not defer to him; therefore he supplied Qian troops and had him profess an edict executing Xi.

units.zh: 晞時已避位，楙在州徵求不已，郡縣不堪命。
units.en: Though Gou Xi had yielded, Mao's exactions broke the commanderies.
units.literal: Xi had already stepped aside, yet Mao in the province demanded endlessly; commanderies and counties could not bear the orders.

units.zh: 范陽王虓遣晞還兗州，徙楙都督青州諸軍事。
units.en: Sima Xiao restored Gou Xi and shifted Mao to Qing theater.
units.literal: Prince Xiao of Fanyang sent Xi back to Yan Province and transferred Mao to supervise Qing military affairs.

units.zh: 楙不受命，背山東諸侯，與豫州刺史劉喬相結。
units.en: Mao rejected the posting, broke with the eastern league, and joined Liu Qiao.
units.literal: Mao refused the order, turned his back on the Shandong princes, and allied with Inspector Qiao of Yu Province Liu.

units.zh: 虓遣將田徽擊楙，破之，楙走還國。
units.en: Tian Hui routed Mao, who bolted for his fief.
units.literal: Xiao dispatched general Tian Hui to strike Mao, defeated him, and Mao fled back to his state.

units.zh: 帝還洛陽，楙乃詣闕。
units.en: When Emperor Hui returned to Luoyang, Mao presented himself at the palace gates.
units.literal: When the emperor returned to Luoyang Mao then presented himself at the palace gates.

units.zh: 及懷帝踐阼，改封竟陵王，拜光祿大夫。
units.en: Huai renamed him prince of Jingling and grand master of splendid horses.
units.literal: When Emperor Huai ascended he changed Mao's enfeoffment to Prince of Jingling and appointed Grand Master of Splendid Carriages.

units.zh: 越出牧豫州，留世子毗及其党何倫訪察宮省。
units.en: Sima Yue took Yu and left heir Pi and He Lun watching the inner court.
units.literal: Yue went out as shepherd of Yu Province, leaving heir Pi and his faction He Lun to spy on the palace.

units.zh: 楙白帝討越，乃合眾襲倫，不克。
units.en: Mao urged Huai to strike Yue, then struck He Lun and failed.
units.literal: Mao informed the emperor to punish Yue; thereupon he gathered forces and attacked Lun but did not overcome him.

units.zh: 帝委罪於楙，楙奔竄獲免。
units.en: Huai blamed Mao, who ran for his life.
units.literal: The emperor shifted blame onto Mao; Mao fled and escaped execution.

units.zh: 越薨，乃出。
units.en: Only after Yue died did Mao surface.
units.literal: When Yue died he then emerged.

units.zh: 及洛陽傾覆，為亂兵所害。
units.en: Luoyang's fall left him slain by rogue soldiers.
units.literal: When Luoyang collapsed he was killed by mutinous troops.

units.zh: 望弟太原成王輔
units.en: Fu, Prince Cheng of Taiyuan—Sima Wang's younger brother.
units.literal: Wang di Taiyuan Cheng Wang Fu.

units.zh: 太原成王輔，魏末為野王太守。
units.en: Late in Wei Sima Fu governed Yewang.
units.literal: Prince Cheng of Taiyuan, Fu, at the end of Wei was governor of Yewang.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封渤海王，邑五千三百七十九戶，泰始二年之國。
units.en: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Bohai with 5,379 households; in Taishi year two, he went to his domain.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Bohai with 5,379 households; in Taishi year two, he went to his domain.

units.zh: 後為衛尉，出為東中郎將，轉南中郎將，咸寧三年，徙為太原王，監并州諸軍事。
units.en: He later served as Commandant of Guards, went out as Gentlemen-General of the East, transferred to Gentlemen-General of the South, and in Xianning year three was moved to Prince of Taiyuan, supervising all military affairs in Bingzhou.
units.literal: He later served as Commandant of Guards, went out as Gentlemen-General of the East, transferred to Gentlemen-General of the South, and in Xianning year three was moved to Prince of Taiyuan, supervising all military affairs in Bingzhou.

units.zh: 太康四年入朝，五年薨，追贈鎮北將軍，
units.en: In Taikang year four he entered court; in year five he died and was posthumously granted General Who Guards the North,
units.literal: In Taikang year four he entered court; in year five he died and was posthumously granted General Who Guards the North,

units.zh: 永平元年，更贈衛將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: and in Yongping year one he was further granted General of the Guards and the privileges of Opening an Office Equal to the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: and in Yongping year one he was further granted General of the Guards and the privileges of Opening an Office Equal to the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 子弘立，元康中為散騎常侍，後徙封中丘王。
units.en: Heir Hong held supernumerary cavalry attendant then moved the title to Zhongqiu.
units.literal: Son Hong succeeded; in Yuankang he was irregular cavalry attendant and later transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Zhongqiu.

units.zh: 三年薨，子鑠立。
units.en: Three years on Shuo inherited.
units.literal: In the third year he died; son Shuo succeeded.

units.zh: 輔弟翼
units.en: Yi—Fu's younger brother.
units.literal: Fu di Yi.

units.zh: 翼字子世，少曆顯位，官至武賁中郎將。
units.en: Sima Yi, styled Zishi, rose young to major among the palace guards.
units.literal: Yi courtesy Zishi in youth successively held eminent posts and reached Major of the Household Guards.

units.zh: 武帝未受禪而卒，以兄邕之支子承為嗣，封南宮縣王。
units.en: He died before the Wei-Jin transition; Yong's collateral heir Cheng took Nangong county.
units.literal: Before Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he died; Yong's cadet son Cheng was appointed successor as Prince of Nangong county.

units.zh: 薨，子祐嗣立，承遂無後。
units.en: When Cheng died You continued the line, ending Cheng's branch.
units.literal: He died; son You succeeded and Cheng thereby had no posterity.

units.zh: 翼弟下邳獻王晃
units.en: Huang, Prince Xian of Xiapi—Yi's younger brother.
units.literal: Yi di Xiapi Offering Wang Huang.

units.zh: 下邳獻王晃字子明，魏封武始亭侯，拜黃門侍郎，改封西安男，出為東莞太守。
units.en: Sima Huang, styled Ziming, began as Wushi ting marquis, yellow-gate gentleman, Xi'an baron, then Dongguan governor.
units.literal: Prince Xian of Xiapi Huang courtesy Ziming was enfeoffed Marquis of Wushi precinct in Wei, appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, changed to Baron of Xi'an, and went out as governor of Dongguan.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封下邳王，邑五千一百七十六戶，泰始二年就國。
units.en: Sima Yan invested him at Xiapi with 5,176 households in 266.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Xiapi with five thousand one hundred seventy-six households and proceeded to his state in Taishi year two.

units.zh: 晃孝友貞廉，謙虛下士，甚得宗室之稱。
units.en: Filial, modest, and scrupulous, he won wide esteem among kinsmen.
units.literal: Huang was filial, friendly, chaste, and honest, humble toward scholars, and greatly earned praise among the imperial clan.

units.zh: 後為長水校尉、南中郎將。
units.en: He later commanded long waters and southern gentlemen.
units.literal: Later he was Colonel of Long Waters and General of the Southern Gentlemen.

units.zh: 九年，詔曰：「南中郎將、下邳王晃清亮中正，體行明潔，才周政理，有文武策識。
units.en: In the ninth year an edict said, 'Southern Gentlemen General Prince of Xiapi Huang is pure, bright, and upright; his conduct is lucid and clean; talent suffices for governance and he possesses civil and military stratagem.
units.literal: In the ninth year an edict said, 'Southern Gentlemen General Prince of Xiapi Huang is pure, bright, and upright; his conduct is lucid and clean; talent suffices for governance and he possesses civil and military stratagem.

units.zh: 其以晃為使持節，都督甯益二州諸軍事、安西將軍，領益州刺史。」
units.en: Let Huang be credential-bearing commissioner supervising Ning and Yi military affairs, General Who Pacifies the West, and concurrently Inspector of Yi Province.'
units.literal: Let Huang be credential-bearing commissioner supervising Ning and Yi military affairs, General Who Pacifies the West, and concurrently Inspector of Yi Province.'

units.zh: 晃以疾不行，更拜尚書，遷右僕射。
units.en: Pleading illness he stayed north and instead took minister of writing and right vice director.
units.literal: Huang pleaded illness and did not go; he was further appointed Minister of Writing and promoted Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 久之，出為鎮東將軍、都督青徐二州諸軍事。
units.en: Years later he commanded Qing and Xu from the east.
units.literal: After a long while he went out as General Who Guards the East supervising Qing and Xu military affairs.

units.zh: 惠帝即位，入為車騎將軍，加散騎常侍。
units.en: Hui made him chariot-and-cavalry chief with supernumerary cavalry attendant.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui ascended he entered as chariot-and-cavalry general with additional irregular cavalry attendant.

units.zh: 將誅楊駿，以晃領護軍，屯東掖門，尋守尚書令。
units.en: During Yang Jun's purge he guarded Dongye Gate then acting minister director.
units.literal: When Yang Jun was to be executed Huang was put in charge of the guards encamped at Dongye Gate and soon held Minister Director.

units.zh: 遷司空，加侍中，令如故。
units.en: He rose to minister of works plus palace attendant, keeping director duties.
units.literal: He was promoted Minister of Works with additional palace attendant while retaining minister director.

units.zh: 元康六年薨，追贈太傅。
units.en: In the sixth year of Yuankang, Death brought posthumous grand mentor.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Yuankang, he died and was posthumously invested Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 二子：裒、綽。
units.en: His sons were Pou and Chuo.
units.literal: Two sons: Pou and Chuo.

units.zh: 裒早卒，綽有篤疾，別封良城縣王，以太原王輔第三子韡為嗣。
units.en: Pou predeceased; frail Chuo took Liangcheng while Taiyuan prince Fu's third son Wei inherited the main title.
units.literal: Pou died early; Chuo had grave illness and separately was enfeoffed Prince of Liangcheng county; the third son Wei of Prince Fu of Taiyuan was made successor.

units.zh: 官至侍中、尚書，早薨，子韶立。
units.en: He died young at palace attendant and minister of writing; Shao followed.
units.literal: He reached palace attendant and minister of writing, died early; son Shao succeeded.

units.zh: 晃弟太原烈王瓌
units.en: Gui, Prince Lie of Taiyuan—Huang's younger brother.
units.literal: Huang di Taiyuan Lie Wang Gui.

units.zh: 太原烈王瓌，字子泉，魏長樂亭侯，改封貴壽鄉侯。
units.en: Sima Gui, styled Ziquan, held Changle ting then Guishou township under Wei.
units.literal: Prince Lie of Taiyuan Gui courtesy Ziquan was Marquis of Changle precinct in Wei and changed to Marquis of Guishou village.

units.zh: 曆振威將軍，秘書監，封固始子。
units.en: He rose through display-might general and palace librarian to Gushi viscount.
units.literal: He successively held General Who Displays Might, Palace Library Supervisor, and was enfeoffed Viscount of Gushi.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封太原王，邑五千四百九十六戶，泰始二年就國。
units.en: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Taiyuan with 5,496 households; in Taishi year two, he went to his state.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Taiyuan with 5,496 households; in Taishi year two, he went to his state.

units.zh: 四年入朝，賜袞冕之服，遷東中郎將。
units.en: Year four brought court robes and eastern gentleman-general rank.
units.literal: In the fourth year he entered court and was granted robe and crown of state; he was promoted General of the Eastern Gentlemen.

units.zh: 十年薨，詔曰：「瑰乃心忠篤，智器雅亮。
units.en: In the tenth year he died; an edict said, 'Gui's heart was loyal and earnest; intellect and capacity were elegant and bright.
units.literal: In the tenth year he died; an edict said, 'Gui's heart was loyal and earnest; intellect and capacity were elegant and bright.

units.zh: 歷位文武，有幹事之績。
units.en: He successively held civil and military posts and had achievements in handling affairs.
units.literal: He successively held civil and military posts and had achievements in handling affairs.

units.zh: 出臨封土，夷夏懷附，鎮守許都，思謀可紀。
units.en: Going out he faced his enfeoffment lands and barbarians and Chinese cherished allegiance; guarding Xu capital his designs merit record.
units.literal: Going out he faced his enfeoffment lands and barbarians and Chinese cherished allegiance; guarding Xu capital his designs merit record.

units.zh: 不幸早薨，朕甚悼之。
units.en: Unluckily he died young; We greatly mourn him.
units.literal: Unluckily he died young; We greatly mourn him.

units.zh: 今安厝在近，其追贈前將軍。」
units.en: Now that burial is near, let him be posthumously invested as Former General."
units.literal: Now that burial is near, let him be posthumously invested as Former General."

units.zh: 子顒立，徙封河間王，別有傳。
units.en: Heir Yong shifted the fief to Hejian—a fuller life appears in a separate biography.
units.literal: Son Yong succeeded, transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Hejian; elsewhere there is a biography.

units.zh: 瑰弟高陽元王珪
units.en: Prince Yuan of Gaoyang, Sima Gui—brother of Prince Lie Sima Gui.
units.literal: Younger brother of Prince Lie Gui: Prince Yuan Gui of Gaoyang.

units.zh: 高陽元王珪，字子璋，少有才望，魏高陽鄉侯。
units.en: Sima Gui, Prince Yuan of Gaoyang, styled Zizhang, had talent and a good reputation in his youth. Under Wei he was Marquis of Gaoyang Village.
units.literal: Prince Yuan of Gaoyang, Gui, courtesy name Zizhang, had talent and a good reputation in his youth and was Marquis of Gaoyang Township under Wei.

units.zh: 曆河南令，進封湞陽子，拜給事黃門侍郎。
units.en: He governed Henan, rose to Zhenyang viscount, then serving yellow-gate gentleman.
units.literal: He successively held magistrate of Henan, advanced to Viscount of Zhenyang, and was appointed Serving Yellow Gate Gentleman.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封高陽王，邑五千五百七十戶。
units.en: Sima Yan invested Gaoyang at 5,570 households.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Gaoyang with five thousand five hundred seventy households.

units.zh: 曆北中郎將、督鄴城守諸軍事。
units.en: He commanded northern gentlemen and Ye defenses.
units.literal: He successively held General of the Northern Gentlemen and supervised Ye city garrison affairs.

units.zh: 泰始六年入朝，以父孚年高，乞留供養。
units.en: In the sixth year of Taishi, Court duty moved him to ask leave to nurse elderly Sima Fu.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Taishi, Entering court because father Fu was advanced in years he begged to remain and provide support.

units.zh: 拜尚書，遷右僕射。
units.en: He took the ministry then right vice director.
units.literal: He was appointed Minister of Writing and promoted Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 十年薨，詔遣兼大鴻臚持節監護喪事，贈車騎將軍、儀同三司。
units.en: Year ten brought supervised obsequies and posthumous chariot-and-cavalry honors matching three-dukes rites.
units.literal: In the tenth year he died; an edict dispatched concurrent Grand Herald with credentials to supervise funeral affairs and posthumously invested chariot-and-cavalry general with ceremonies equal to the Three Dukes.

units.zh: 珪有美譽於世，而帝甚悼惜之。
units.en: Celebrated publicly, he won uncommon imperial grief.
units.literal: Gui had fine reputation in the world yet the emperor deeply mourned and cherished him.

units.zh: 無子，詔以太原王輔子緝襲爵。
units.en: Without issue Taiyuan prince Fu's son Ji inherited.
units.literal: Having no son an edict ordered Prince Fu of Taiyuan's son Ji to inherit the noble rank.

units.zh: 緝立五年，咸寧四年薨，諡曰哀。
units.en: Ji had held the title for five years when he died in Xianning year four, receiving the posthumous epithet Ai.
units.literal: Ji had held the title for five years when he died in Xianning year four, receiving the posthumous epithet Ai.

units.zh: 無子，太康二年詔以太原王瑰世子顒子訟為緝後，封真定縣侯。
units.en: Having no son, in Taikang year two an edict made Song, son of Yong, heir of the heir apparent of Prince Gui of Taiyuan, continue Ji's line and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Zhending County.
units.literal: Having no son, in Taikang year two an edict made Song, son of Yong, heir of the heir apparent of Prince Gui of Taiyuan, continue Ji's line and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Zhending County.

units.zh: 珪弟常山孝王衡
units.en: Heng, Prince Xiao of Changshan—Gui's younger brother.
units.literal: Gui di Changshan Xiao Wang Heng.

units.zh: 常山孝王衡，字子平，魏封德陽鄉侯。
units.en: Sima Heng, styled Ziping, held Deyang village under Wei.
units.literal: Prince Xiao of Changshan Heng courtesy Ziping was Deyang village marquis in Wei.

units.zh: 進封汝陽子，為駙馬都尉。
units.en: Promotion brought Runyang viscount and commandant for princess consorts.
units.literal: He advanced to Viscount of Runyang and became Commandant Steadfast for imperial sons-in-law.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封常山王，邑三千七百九十戶。
units.en: Sima Yan named him Changshan prince at 3,790 households.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Changshan with three thousand seven hundred ninety households.

units.zh: 二年薨，無子，以安平世子邕第四子敦為嗣。
units.en: Childless after two years Yong's fourth son Dun succeeded.
units.literal: In the second year he died without sons; Yong heir Yong's fourth son Dun was appointed successor.

units.zh: 衡弟沛順王景
units.en: Jing, Prince Shun of Pei—Heng's younger brother.
units.literal: Heng di Pei Shun Wang Jing.

units.zh: 沛順王景，字子文，魏樂安亭侯。
units.en: Sima Jing, styled Ziwen, began as Leyang ting marquis.
units.literal: Prince Shun of Pei Jing courtesy Ziwen was Leyang precinct marquis in Wei.

units.zh: 曆諫議大夫。
units.en: He served as grand counselor of remonstrance.
units.literal: He successively held Grand Counselor.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封沛王，邑三千四百戶。
units.en: Sima Yan invested Pei at 3,400 households.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Pei with three thousand four hundred households.

units.zh: 立十一年，咸寧元年薨，子韜立。
units.en: After holding the title for eleven years, he died in Xianning year one, and his son Tao succeeded.
units.literal: After holding the title for eleven years, he died in Xianning year one, and his son Tao succeeded.

units.zh: 彭城穆王權
units.en: Quan, Prince Mu of Pengcheng.
units.literal: Prince Mu of Pengcheng Quan.

units.zh: 彭城穆王權，字子輿，宣帝弟魏魯相東武城侯馗之子也。
units.en: Sima Quan, King Mu of Pengcheng and styled Ziyu, was the son of Sima Kui, Marquis of Dongwucheng and governor of Lu under Wei, who was Sima Yi's younger brother.
units.literal: Prince Mu of Pengcheng Quan courtesy Ziyu was son of Emperor Xuan's younger brother Wei Lu governor East Wucheng Marquis Kui.

units.zh: 初襲封，拜冗從僕射。
units.en: He opened as supernumerary chariot master.
units.literal: At first inheriting the enfeoffment he was appointed Supernumerary Master of Chariots.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封彭城王，邑二千九百戶。
units.en: Sima Yan made him Pengcheng prince at 2,900 households.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Pengcheng with two thousand nine hundred households.

units.zh: 出為北中郎將、都督鄴城守諸軍事。
units.en: He commanded Ye's northern gentleman garrison.
units.literal: He went out as General of the Northern Gentlemen supervising Ye city garrison affairs.

units.zh: 泰始中入朝，賜袞冕之服。
units.en: Mid-Taishi brought court investiture robes.
units.literal: In Taishi mid-years he entered court and was granted robe and crown of state.

units.zh: 咸甯元年薨，子元王植立。
units.en: 275 death; Yuan prince Zhi followed.
units.literal: In Xianning year one he died; son Prince Yuan Zhi succeeded.

units.zh: 歷位後將軍，尋拜國子祭酒、太僕卿、侍中、尚書。
units.en: His offices ran rear general, academy libationer, coach minister, palace attendant, and ministry.
units.literal: He successively held Later General, soon appointed Libationer of the Imperial Academy, Minister of Coachmanship, palace attendant, and minister of writing.

units.zh: 出為安東將軍、都督揚州諸軍事，代淮南王允鎮壽春，未發。
units.en: Named east-pacifier for Yangzhou replacing Yun at Shouchun, he never took up post.
units.literal: He was going out as General Who Pacifies the East supervising Yangzhou military affairs replacing Prince Huainan Yun at Shouchun but did not depart.

units.zh: 或云植助允攻趙王倫，遂以憂薨。
units.en: Tradition claims he aided Yun against Sima Lun and died of anxiety.
units.literal: Some say Zhi assisted Yun in attacking Prince Zhao Lun and therefore died of grief.

units.zh: 贈車騎將軍，增封萬五千戶。
units.en: The court added posthumous chariot-and-cavalry honors and boosted his fief by fifteen thousand households.
units.literal: He was posthumously invested chariot-and-cavalry general and his enfeoffment was increased by fifteen thousand households.

units.zh: 子康王釋立，官至南中郎將、持節、平南將軍，分魯國蕃、薛二縣以益其國，心二萬三千戶。
