units.en: Prince Kang Sima Shi rose to southern gentleman-general with pacifying-south command, annexed Fan and Xue from Lu, and held twenty-three thousand households.
units.literal: Son Prince Kang Shi succeeded; he reached Southern Gentlemen General, credential-bearing, Pacifying South General; partitioned Fan and Xue counties of Lu to enlarge his state; total twenty-three thousand households.

units.zh: 薨，子雄立，坐奔蘇峻伏誅，更以釋子紘嗣。
units.en: After his death Xiong inherited but died with Su Jun's rebellion; Hong, son of Shi, continued the line.
units.literal: He died; son Xiong succeeded; Xiong was executed for fleeing to Su Jun; Shi's son Hong was changed to succeed.

units.zh: 曾孫紘
units.en: The great-grandson Hong.
units.literal: Great-grandson Hong.

units.zh: 紘字偉德，初封堂邑縣公。
units.en: Sima Hong, styled Weide, began as duke of Tangyi county.
units.literal: Hong courtesy Weide at first was enfeoffed Duke of Tangyi county.

units.zh: 建興末，元帝承制，以紘繼高密王據。
units.en: Late in Jianxing Sima Rui assigned Hong to continue Prince Ju of Gaomi's line.
units.literal: At the end of Jianxing Yuan Di under emergency regulations ordered Hong to succeed Prince of Gaomi Ju.

units.zh: 及帝即位，拜散騎侍郎，遷翊軍校尉、前將軍。
units.en: After enthronement Hong became supernumerary cavalry attendant, then aide-army colonel and former general.
units.literal: When the emperor ascended the throne Hong was appointed irregular cavalry gentleman and promoted Colonel Who Aids the Army and Former General.

units.zh: 雄之誅也，紘入繼本宗。
units.en: Xiong's execution brought Hong back into his birth house.
units.literal: When Xiong was executed Hong entered to succeed his root lineage.

units.zh: 拜國子祭酒，加散騎常侍，尋遷大宗正、秘書監。
units.en: He directed the academy with supernumerary cavalry rank, then headed the imperial clan office and palace library.
units.literal: He was appointed Libationer of the Imperial Academy with additional irregular cavalry attendant; soon promoted Grand Director of the Imperial Clan and Palace Library Supervisor.

units.zh: 有風疾，性理不恆。
units.en: Windstroke unsettled his temperament.
units.literal: He had wind illness and his disposition was not constant.

units.zh: 或欲上疏陳事，曆示公卿。
units.en: He would draft memorials and parade them past the high ministers.
units.literal: Sometimes he wished to submit memorials stating affairs and showed them in turn to dukes and ministers.

units.zh: 又杜門讓還章印貂蟬，著《杜門賦》以顯其志。
units.en: He sealed his gates, tried to return insignia, and wrote a rhapsody proclaiming reclusion.
units.literal: Again he shut his gate declining to return seals and courtier insignia and composed 'Rhapsody on Shutting the Gate' to display his intent.

units.zh: 由是更拜光祿大夫，領大宗師，常侍如故。
units.en: The court named him splendid-carriages grand master with clan-director duties while keeping cavalry attendant.
units.literal: Thereupon he was further appointed Grand Master of Splendid Carriages concurrent Grand Master of the Imperial Clan while irregular attendant remained as before.

units.zh: 後疾甚，馳騁無度，或攻劫軍寺，或扞傷官屬，醜言悖詈，誹謗上下。
units.en: Madness drove him to reckless rides, assaults on yamen, beatings of staff, and foul-mouthed outbursts against everyone.
units.literal: Later his illness grew severe; he galloped without restraint, sometimes raiding military offices, sometimes striking officials, ugly words and abusive curses slandering superiors and subordinates.

units.zh: 又乘車突入端門，至太極殿前。
units.en: He rammed a cart through the main palace gate to Taiji's steps.
units.literal: He also drove a carriage crashing through the Vermilion Gate to the forecourt of Taiji Hall.

units.zh: 於是御史中丞車灌奏劾，請免紘官，下其國嚴加防錄。
units.en: Censor-in-chief Che Guan demanded Hong's removal and house arrest in his domain.
units.literal: Thereupon Palace Assistant chief Che Guan impeached him requesting Hong be dismissed and his state strictly confined.

units.zh: 成帝詔曰：「王以明德茂親，居宗師之重，宜敷道養德，靜一其操。
units.en: Emperor Cheng's edict said, 'The prince by bright virtue as a lush kinsman occupies the weight of clan tutor—he ought to spread the Way and nurture virtue and quiet his conduct.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng's edict said, 'The prince by bright virtue as a lush kinsman occupies the weight of clan tutor—he ought to spread the Way and nurture virtue and quiet his conduct.

units.zh: 而頃遊行煩數，冒履風塵。
units.en: Yet lately his roaming has been frequent and he braves wind and dust.
units.literal: Yet lately his roaming has been frequent and he braves wind and dust.

units.zh: 宜令官屬已下，各以職奉衛，不得令王復有此勞。
units.en: Let officials under his household each according to duty attend him and not allow the prince again such labor.
units.literal: Let officials under his household each according to duty attend him and not allow the prince again such labor.

units.zh: 內外職司，各慎其局。
units.en: Inner and outer offices each must be careful of their sphere.
units.literal: Inner and outer offices each must be careful of their sphere.

units.zh: 王可解常侍、光祿、宗師，先所給車牛可錄取，賜米布床帳以養疾。」
units.en: The prince may be relieved of the posts of Regular Attendant, Guanglu, and clan tutor; the carts and oxen formerly supplied may be withdrawn; grant rice, cloth, bed, and curtain to nurse his illness."
units.literal: The prince may be relieved of the posts of Regular Attendant, Guanglu, and clan tutor; the carts and oxen formerly supplied may be withdrawn; grant rice, cloth, bed, and curtain to nurse his illness."

units.zh: 咸康八年薨，贈散騎常侍、金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: He died in Xiankang year eight and was posthumously granted Regular Mounted Attendant and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon.
units.literal: He died in Xiankang year eight and was posthumously granted Regular Mounted Attendant and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon.

units.zh: 二子：玄、俊。
units.en: He left sons Xuan and Jun.
units.literal: Two sons: Xuan and Jun.

units.zh: 玄嗣立。
units.en: Xuan inherited.
units.literal: Xuan succeeded.

units.zh: 會庚戌制不得藏戶，玄匿五戶，桓溫表玄犯禁，收付廷尉。
units.en: Household reform caught Xuan hiding five families; Huan Wen sent him to justice.
units.literal: When the gengxu household-registration reform forbade concealing households Xuan hid five households; Huan Wen memorialized the offense and had him seized for the Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 既而宥之，位至中書侍郎。
units.en: He won amnesty and rose to secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: He was soon pardoned and reached Palace Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 薨，子弘之立，位至散騎常侍。
units.en: When he died, his son Hongzhi succeeded him and rose to Regular Mounted Attendant.
units.literal: He died; his son Hongzhi succeeded and rose to Regular Mounted Attendant.

units.zh: 薨，子邵之立。
units.en: He died, and his son Shaozhi succeeded him.
units.literal: He died; son Shaozhi succeeded.

units.zh: 薨，子崇之立。
units.en: He died, and his son Chongzhi succeeded him.
units.literal: He died; son Chongzhi succeeded.

units.zh: 薨，子緝之立。
units.en: He died, and his son Jizhi succeeded him.
units.literal: He died; son Jizhi succeeded.

units.zh: 宋受禪，國除。
units.en: The Liu Song takeover ended the principality.
units.literal: When Song accepted the abdication the state was abolished.

units.zh: 紘子俊
units.en: Hong's son Jun.
units.literal: Hong's son Jun.

units.zh: 恭王俊字道度，出嗣高密王略，官至散騎常侍。
units.en: Prince Gong Sima Jun, styled Daodu, continued Lue of Gaomi and rose to supernumerary cavalry attendant.
units.literal: Prince Gong Jun courtesy Daodu went out to succeed Prince of Gaomi Lue and reached irregular cavalry attendant.

units.zh: 薨，子敬王純之立，曆臨川內史、司農少府卿、太宰右長史。
units.en: When he died, his son Chunzhi, Prince Jing, succeeded him. He successively served as administrator of Linchuan, minister of agriculture, minister of the privy treasury, and right chief clerk to the Grand Steward.
units.literal: He died; his son Chunzhi, Prince Jing, succeeded him and successively held the offices of administrator of Linchuan, minister of agriculture, minister of the privy treasury, and right chief clerk to the Grand Steward.

units.zh: 薨，子恢之立。
units.en: He died, and his son Huizhi succeeded him.
units.literal: He died; son Huizhi succeeded.

units.zh: 義熙末，以給事中兼太尉，修謁洛陽園陵。
units.en: Late in Yixi he doubled as grand commandant tending western tombs.
units.literal: At the end of Yixi he as consultant concurrently grand commandant repaired and visited Luoyang mausolea.

units.zh: 宋受禪，國除。
units.en: Liu Song shuttered the fief.
units.literal: When Song accepted the abdication the state was abolished.

units.zh: 高密文獻王泰
units.en: Sima Tai, Prince Wenxian of Gaomi.
units.literal: Prince Wenxian of Gaomi Tai.

units.zh: 高密文獻王泰，字子舒，彭城穆王權之弟，魏陽亭侯，補陽翟令，遷扶風太守。
units.en: Sima Tai, styled Zishu, was Sima Quan's brother—Yang ting marquis, Yangdi magistrate, Fufeng governor.
units.literal: Prince Wenxian of Gaomi Tai courtesy Zishu was younger brother of Prince Mu of Pengcheng Quan, Marquis of Yang precinct in Wei; supplied Yangdi magistrate; promoted governor of Fufeng.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封隴西王，邑三千二百戶，拜遊擊將軍。
units.en: Sima Yan made him Longxi prince at 3,200 households with roving-strike command.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Longxi with three thousand two hundred households and appointed roving-strike general.

units.zh: 出為兗州刺史，加鷹揚將軍。
units.en: He shepherded Yan with hawk-banner general rank.
units.literal: He went out as Inspector of Yan Province with additional general Who Displays Hawk banner.

units.zh: 遷使持節、都督甯益二州諸軍事、安西將軍，領益州刺史，稱疾不行。
units.en: Ning-Yi pacifying-west orders went unfulfilled on grounds of illness.
units.literal: He was promoted credential-bearing supervisor of Ning and Yi military affairs and Pacifying West General concurrent Yi Inspector but pleaded illness and did not go.

units.zh: 轉安北將軍，代兄權督鄴城守事。
units.en: He succeeded brother Quan as pacifying-north chief at Ye.
units.literal: He transferred to Pacifying North General replacing elder brother Quan supervising Ye garrison.

units.zh: 安西將軍、都督關中事。
units.en: He also held pacifying-west charge over Guanzhong.
units.literal: Pacifying West General supervising Guanzhong affairs.

units.zh: 太康初，入為散騎常侍、前將軍，領鄴城門校尉，以疾去官。
units.en: Early Taikang brought palace posts and Ye gate command until illness retired him.
units.literal: Early Taikang he entered as irregular cavalry attendant and former general concurrent colonel of Ye gates but resigned for illness.

units.zh: 後代下邳王晃為尚書左僕射。
units.en: He later succeeded Sima Huang as left vice director.
units.literal: Later he replaced Prince of Xiapi Huang as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 出為鎮西將軍，領護西戎校尉、假節，代扶風王駿都督關中軍事，以疾還京師。
units.en: He was sent out as General Who Guards the West, concurrently Colonel Protector of the Western Rong and Bearer of the Staff, replacing Prince Jun of Fufeng as commander of Guanzhong military affairs, but returned to the capital because of illness.
units.literal: He went out as Guarding West General concurrent colonel of western tribes with credentials replacing Prince of Fufeng Jun supervising Guanzhong military affairs but returned to capital for illness.

units.zh: 永熙初，代石鑒為司空，尋領太子太保。
units.en: Yongxi opened with minister of works and heir-apparent junior tutor posts.
units.literal: Early Yongxi he replaced Shi Jian as Minister of Works and soon concurrent junior tutor to heir apparent.

units.zh: 及楊駿誅，泰領駿營，加侍中，給步兵二千五百人，騎五百匹。
units.en: Jun's purge handed Tai the camp plus two thousand five hundred foot and five hundred horse.
units.literal: When Yang Jun was executed Tai took over Jun's camp with additional palace attendant, two thousand five hundred infantry, and five hundred cavalry granted.

units.zh: 泰固辭，乃給千兵百騎。
units.en: He bargained the guard down to one thousand foot and one hundred horse.
units.literal: Tai firmly declined so only one thousand troops and one hundred cavalry were given.

units.zh: 楚王瑋之被收，泰嚴兵將救之，祭酒丁綏諫曰：「公為宰相，不可輕動。
units.en: When Prince of Chu Wei was seized Tai drew up troops intending to rescue him; Libationer Ding Sui remonstrated saying, 'You are chief minister—you cannot move rashly.
units.literal: When Prince of Chu Wei was seized Tai drew up troops intending to rescue him; Libationer Ding Sui remonstrated saying, 'You are chief minister—you cannot move rashly.

units.zh: 且夜中倉卒，宜遣人參審定問。」
units.en: Moreover midnight crisis requires sending men to investigate clearly.'
units.literal: Moreover midnight crisis requires sending men to investigate clearly.'

units.zh: 泰從之。
units.en: Tai agreed.
units.literal: Tai followed this.

units.zh: 瑋既誅，乃以泰錄尚書事，遷太尉，守尚書令，改封高密王，邑萬戶。
units.en: Wei's fall made Tai acting minister chief, then grand commandant with Gaomi at ten thousand households.
units.literal: After Wei was executed Tai was put in charge of Ministry records, promoted Grand Commandant while holding Minister Director, changed enfeoffment to Prince of Gaomi with ten thousand households.

units.zh: 元康九年薨，追贈太傅。
units.en: In the ninth year of Yuankang, Posthumous grand mentor followed his death.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Yuankang, he died and was posthumously invested Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 泰性廉靜，不近聲色。
units.en: Chaste and retiring, he shunned entertainment and concubines.
units.literal: Tai's nature was honest and quiet; he did not draw near music and women.

units.zh: 雖為宰輔，食大國之租，服飾肴膳如布衣寒士。
units.en: Despite ministerial income he dressed and ate like a poor scholar.
units.literal: Though he was chief minister eating great-state rents his dress and food were like a poor commoner scholar.

units.zh: 任真簡率，每朝會，不識者不知其王公也。
units.en: At audience strangers mistook him for a common official.
units.literal: Straightforward and plain at court assemblies strangers did not know he was a prince duke.

units.zh: 事視恭謹，居喪哀戚，謙虛下物，為宗室儀錶。
units.en: Filial in mourning and deferential, he set clan standard.
units.literal: Serving kin he was respectful and cautious; in mourning grief-stricken; humble toward others—he was model for the imperial clan.

units.zh: 當時諸王，惟泰及下邳王晃以節制見稱。
units.en: Only Tai and Sima Huang won esteem for self-control.
units.literal: Among princes of the time only Tai and Prince of Xiapi Huang were praised for restraint.

units.zh: 雖並不能振施，其餘莫得比焉。
units.en: Neither dispensed charity widely yet none surpassed their discipline.
units.literal: Though neither could relieve distress broadly none others matched them.

units.zh: 泰四子：越、騰、略、模。
units.en: Four sons: Yue, Teng, Lue, Mo.
units.literal: Tai had four sons: Yue, Teng, Lue, Mo.

units.zh: 越自有傳。
units.en: Yue appears elsewhere.
units.literal: Yue has his own biography.

units.zh: 騰出後叔父，弟略立。
units.en: Teng was adopted out; Lue inherited.
units.literal: Teng went out to succeed uncle; younger brother Lue succeeded.

units.zh: 子孝王略
units.en: Prince Xiao Sima Lue.
units.literal: Son Prince Xiao Lue.

units.zh: 孝王略，字元簡，孝敬慈順，小心下士，少有父風。
units.en: Sima Lue, styled Yuanjian, echoed his father's modest courtesy.
units.literal: Prince Xiao Lue courtesy Yuanjian was respectful, mild, and obedient, humble toward scholars, having somewhat his father's manner.

units.zh: 元康初，湣懷太子在東宮，選大臣子弟有名稱者以為賓友，略與華恆等並侍左右。
units.en: Yuankang saw Lue among Minhuai's cultivated companions with Hua Heng.
units.literal: Early Yuankang Crown Prince Minhuai was in the eastern palace and chose sons of eminent ministers with reputation as guests and friends; Lue together with Hua Heng and others attended left and right.

units.zh: 曆散騎黃門侍郎、散騎常侍、秘書監，出為安南將軍、持節、都督沔南諸軍事，遷安北將軍、都督青州諸軍事。
units.en: He successively served as Yellow-Gate Gentleman Attendant, Regular Palace Attendant, and Director of the Palace Library; then he was sent out as General Who Pacifies the South, Bearer of the Staff, and commander of the armies south of the Mian, before being promoted to General Who Pacifies the North and commander of Qing Province military affairs.
units.literal: He successively held irregular cavalry yellow-gate gentleman, irregular cavalry attendant, palace library supervisor; went out Pacifying South General credential-bearing supervising Hannan military affairs; promoted Pacifying North General supervising Qing province military affairs.

units.zh: 略逼青州刺史程牧，牧避之，略自領州。
units.en: He bullied Cheng Mu aside and seized Qingzhou himself.
units.literal: Lue pressured Qing Inspector Cheng Mu until Mu yielded and Lue personally headed the province.

units.zh: 永興初，㡉令劉根起兵東萊，誑惑百姓，眾以萬數，攻略於臨淄，略不能距，走保聊城。
units.en: Yongxing opened with Liu Gen's Donglai rising that drove Lue from Linzi to Liaocheng.
units.literal: Early Yongxing Magistrate Liu Gen of Yi county raised troops in Donglai deluding commoners tens of thousands strong raiding Lue at Linzi; Lue could not resist and fled defending Liaocheng.

units.zh: 懷帝即位，遷使持節、都督荊州諸軍事、征南大將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: Huai made him credential-bearing Jing commander with three-dukes parity staff.
units.literal: When Emperor Huai ascended Lue was promoted credential-bearing supervisor of Jing military affairs, southern expedition grand marshal with independent headquarters matching Three Lords.

units.zh: 京兆流人王逌與叟人郝洛聚眾數千，屯于冠軍。
units.en: Wang You, a displaced person from Jingzhao, and Hao Luo of the Sou people gathered several thousand followers and encamped at Guanjun.
units.literal: Wang You, a displaced person from Jingzhao, and Hao Luo of the Sou people gathered several thousand followers and encamped at Guanjun.

units.zh: 略遣參軍崔曠率將軍皮初、張洛等討逌，為逌所譎，戰敗。
units.en: Lue sent his military adviser Cui Kuang to lead the generals Pi Chu, Zhang Luo, and others against You, but You deceived them and they were defeated in battle.
units.literal: Lue sent his military adviser Cui Kuang to lead the generals Pi Chu, Zhang Luo, and others against You, but You deceived them and they were defeated in battle.

units.zh: 略更遣左司馬曹攄統曠等進逼逌。
units.en: Lue then sent Left Sima Cao Shu to lead Kuang and the others in advancing against You.
units.literal: Lue then sent Left Sima Cao Shu to lead Kuang and the others in advancing against You.

units.zh: 將大戰，曠在後密自退走，攄軍無繼，戰敗，死之。
units.en: As they were about to fight a major battle, Kuang, who was in the rear, secretly withdrew; Shu's army was left without support, was defeated, and Shu died in the fighting.
units.literal: As they were about to fight a major battle, Kuang, who was in the rear, secretly withdrew; Shu's army was left without support, was defeated, and Shu died in the fighting.

units.zh: 略乃赦曠罪，復遣部將韓松又督曠攻逌，逌降。
units.en: Lue then pardoned Kuang's offense and again sent his subordinate Han Song to lead Kuang against Wang You, who surrendered.
units.literal: Lue then pardoned Kuang's offense and again sent his subordinate general Han Song to command Kuang in attacking You; You surrendered.

units.zh: 尋進開府，加散騎常侍。
units.en: Soon he was advanced and allowed to establish his own office, with the additional appointment of Regular Mounted Attendant.
units.literal: Soon he was advanced and allowed to establish his own office, with the additional appointment of Regular Mounted Attendant.

units.zh: 永嘉三年薨，追贈侍中、太尉，子據立。
units.en: He died in the third year of Yongjia and was posthumously granted the offices of Palace Attendant and Grand Commandant; his son Ju succeeded him.
units.literal: In the third year of Yongjia, he died and was posthumously granted the offices of Palace Attendant and Grand Commandant; his son Ju succeeded him.

units.zh: 薨，無子，以彭城康王子紘為嗣。
units.en: Childless, he passed to Hong from Pengcheng's Kang line.
units.literal: He died without sons; Prince Kang of Pengcheng's son Hong was appointed successor.

units.zh: 其後紘歸本宗，立紘子俊以奉其祀。
units.en: Hong reverted to his birth house; Jun kept Lue's line alive.
units.literal: Later Hong returned to root lineage; Hong's son Jun was established to maintain his sacrifices.

units.zh: 略兄新蔡武哀王騰
units.en: Lue's elder brother Sima Teng, Prince Wuai of Xincai.
units.literal: Lue's elder brother Prince Wuai of Xincai Teng.

units.zh: 新蔡武哀王騰，字元邁，少拜冗從僕射，封東嬴公，曆南陽、魏郡太守，所在稱職，徵為宗正，遷太常，轉持節、寧北將軍、都督并州諸軍事、并州刺史。
units.en: Sima Teng, Prince Wuai of Xincai, courtesy name Yuanmai, was appointed Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant when young and enfeoffed as Duke of Dongying. He served successively as governor of Nanyang and Wei Commandery, was praised as competent wherever he served, was summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan, promoted to Minister of Ceremonies, and then transferred as Bearer of the Staff, General Who Pacifies the North, commander of all military affairs in Bing Province, and inspector of Bing Province.
units.literal: Prince Wuai of Xincai Teng courtesy Yuanmai in youth was appointed supernumerary chariot master and enfeoffed Duke of Dongying; successively governor of Nanyang and Wei commandery where he was praised competent; summoned Grand Director of the Imperial Clan; promoted Minister of Ceremonies; transferred credential-bearing Pacifying North General supervising Bing military affairs and Bing Inspector.

units.zh: 惠帝討成都王穎，六軍敗績。
units.en: Hui's expedition against Sima Ying collapsed.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui campaigned against Prince of Chengdu Ying the six armies were routed.

units.zh: 騰與安北將軍王浚共殺穎所署幽州刺史和演，率眾討穎。
units.en: Teng joined Wang Jun executing He Yan then marched on Ying.
units.literal: Teng together with Pacifying North General Wang Jun jointly killed Inspector of You appointed by Ying—He Yan—and led hosts against Ying.

units.zh: 穎遣北中郎將王斌距戰，浚率鮮卑騎擊斌，騰為後系，大破之。
units.en: Xianbei cavalry under Wang Jun shattered Wang Bin while Teng held the rear.
units.literal: Ying dispatched Northern Gentlemen General Wang Bin to resist; Jun led Xianbei horse striking Bin while Teng covered the rear routing them utterly.

units.zh: 穎懼，挾帝歸洛陽，進騰位安北將軍。
units.en: Ying was afraid and took Emperor Hui back to Luoyang; Teng was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
units.literal: Ying feared and escorted the emperor back to Luoyang; Teng was advanced Pacifying North General.

units.zh: 永嘉初，遷車騎將軍，都督鄴城守諸軍事，鎮鄴。
units.en: Yongjia named him chariot-and-cavalry chief at Ye.
units.literal: Early Yongjia he was promoted chariot-and-cavalry general supervising Ye garrison stationed at Ye.

units.zh: 又以迎駕之勳，改封新蔡王。
units.en: Welcoming the throne earned the Xincai princedom.
units.literal: Again for merit welcoming the imperial carriage his enfeoffment was changed Prince of Xincai.

units.zh: 初，騰發并州，次於真定。
units.en: Leaving Bing he paused at Zhending.
units.literal: At first when Teng set out from Bing Province he halted at Zhending.

units.zh: 值大雪，平地數尺，營門前方數丈雪融不積，騰怪而掘之，得玉馬，高尺許，表獻之。
units.en: Snow melted oddly at his gate; digging revealed a jade horse sent to court.
units.literal: It happened there was great snow several chi deep on level ground; before the camp gate several zhang of ground showed melted snow not accumulating; Teng wondered and dug obtaining a jade horse about a chi high which he memorialized and presented.

units.zh: 其後公師籓與平陽人汲桑等為群盜，起於清河鄃縣，眾千餘人，寇頓丘，以葬成都王穎為辭，載穎主而行，與張泓故將李豐等將攻鄴。
units.en: Ji Sang's gang marched under Ying's tablet to threaten Ye.
units.literal: Later duke-lord Shi Fan with Pingyang men Ji Sang and others formed bandit gangs rising in Shu county of Qinghe over one thousand strong raiding Dunqiu using burying Prince of Chengdu Ying as pretext loading Ying's spirit tablet marching with Zhang Hong's old general Li Feng intending to attack Ye.

units.zh: 騰曰：「孤在并州七年，胡圍城不能克。
units.en: Teng said, 'I was at Bing seven years and barbarians besieging the city could not overcome it.
units.literal: Teng said, 'I was at Bing seven years and barbarians besieging the city could not overcome it.

units.zh: 汲桑小賊，何足憂也。」
units.en: Ji Sang petty bandits—what worth worry.'
units.literal: Ji Sang petty bandits—what worth worry.'

units.zh: 及豐等至，騰不能守，率輕騎而走，為豐所害。
units.en: The raid overwhelmed him; fleeing lightly armed he fell to Feng.
units.literal: When Feng and others arrived Teng could not defend and led light horse fleeing and was killed by Feng.

units.zh: 四子：虞、矯、紹、確。
units.en: Four sons survived: Yu, Jiao, Shao, Que.
units.literal: Four sons: Yu, Jiao, Shao, Que.

units.zh: 虞有勇力，騰之被害，虞逐豐，豐投水而死。
units.en: Yu avenged his father driving Feng into the river.
units.literal: Yu had courage and strength; when Teng was harmed Yu pursued Feng who threw himself in water and died.

units.zh: 是日，虞及矯、紹並钜鹿太守崔曼、車騎長史羊恆、從事中郎蔡克等又為豐餘黨所害，及諸名家流移依鄴者，死亡並盡。
units.en: The bloodbath wiped Julu officials and refugee clans at Ye.
units.literal: That same day Yu together with Jiao and Shao and Julu governor Cui Man chariot-and-cavalry chief clerk Yang Heng consultant Cai Ke were again harmed by Feng's remaining faction and renowned families taking refuge at Ye perished altogether.

units.zh: 初，鄴中雖府庫虛竭，而騰資用甚饒。
units.en: Ye's arsenals stood empty yet Teng hoarded wealth.
units.literal: At first though Ye granaries were exhausted Teng's private wealth was very ample.

units.zh: 性儉嗇，無所振惠，臨急，乃賜將士米可數升，帛各丈尺，是以人不為用，遂致於禍。
units.en: His miserly handfuls of grain and cloth bought no loyalty and brought disaster.
units.literal: By nature stingy he showed no generosity; facing crisis he then gifted officers several sheng of rice and bolts only one zhang therefore men would not serve him and ruin followed.

units.zh: 及苟晞救鄴，桑還平陽。
units.en: Gou Xi's relief sent Ji Sang back toward Pingyang.
units.literal: When Gou Xi relieved Ye Sang returned to Pingyang.

units.zh: 于時盛夏，屍爛壞不可復識，騰及三子骸骨不獲。
units.en: It was midsummer, and the corpses had decayed beyond recognition; the remains of Teng and his three sons could not be recovered.
units.literal: It was then deep summer; corpses rotted beyond recognition and Teng's and his three sons' bones could not be recovered.

units.zh: 庶子確立。
units.en: His son by a secondary consort, Sima Que, succeeded him.
units.literal: His son by a secondary consort, Que, succeeded him.

units.zh: 莊王確，字嗣安，曆東中郎將、都督豫州諸軍事，鎮許昌。
units.en: Sima Que, Prince Zhuang, styled Si'an, successively served as General of the Gentlemen of the Household of the East and supervised the military affairs of Yu Province, stationed at Xuchang.
units.literal: Prince Zhuang Que, courtesy name Si'an, successively served as General of the Gentlemen of the Household of the East and supervised the military affairs of Yu Province, stationed at Xuchang.

units.zh: 永嘉末，為石勒所害。
units.en: Shi Le killed him at Yongjia's close.
units.literal: At the end of Yongjia he was harmed by Shi Le.

units.zh: 無子，初以章武王混子滔奉其祀，其後復以汝南威王祐子弼為確後。
units.en: He had no sons. At first Tao, son of Hun, Prince of Zhangwu, was appointed to maintain his sacrifices; afterward Bi, son of You, Prince Wei of Runan, was made Que's heir.
units.literal: He had no sons. At first Tao, son of Hun, Prince of Zhangwu, was appointed to maintain his sacrifices; afterward Bi, son of You, Prince Wei of Runan, was made Que's heir.

units.zh: 太興元年薨，無子，又以弼弟邈嗣確，位至侍中。
units.en: In the first year of Taixing, Bi died without sons. His younger brother Miao was then made Que's successor and rose to Palace Attendant.
units.literal: In the first year of Taixing, Bi died without sons. His younger brother Miao was then made Que's successor and rose to Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 薨，子晃立，拜散騎侍郎。
units.en: Huang inherited as supernumerary cavalry attendant.
units.literal: He died; son Huang succeeded appointed irregular cavalry gentleman.

units.zh: 桓溫廢武陵王，免晃為庶人，徙衡陽。
units.en: Huan Wen's coup reduced Huang to commoner exile in Hengyang.
units.literal: When Huan Wen deposed Prince of Wuling Huang was degraded commoner and banished Hengyang.

units.zh: 孝武帝立晃弟崇繼邈後，為奴所害，子惠立。
units.en: Chong continued Miao yet fell to household slaves; Hui followed.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu enthroned Huang's younger brother Chong continued Miao's line and was harmed by slaves; son Hui succeeded.

units.zh: 宋受禪，國除。
units.en: Liu Song ended the fief.
units.literal: When Song accepted the abdication the state was abolished.

units.zh: 略弟南陽王模
units.en: Sima Mo, Prince of Nanyang—Lue's brother.
units.literal: Younger brother of Lue Mo Prince of Nanyang.

units.zh: 南陽王模，字元表，少好學，與元帝及范陽王虓俱有稱於宗室。
units.en: Mo, styled Yuanbiao, studied hard alongside Sima Rui and Sima Xiao.
units.literal: Prince of Nanyang Mo courtesy Yuanbiao in youth loved learning and together with Yuan Di and Prince Xiao of Fanyang was praised within the imperial clan.

units.zh: 初封平昌公。
units.en: He began as Pingchang duke.
units.literal: At first enfeoffed Duke of Pingchang.

units.zh: 惠帝末，拜冗從僕射，累遷太子庶子、員外散騎常侍。
units.en: Late Hui's reign brought chariot master through heir staff to supernumerary cavalry attendant.
units.literal: Late Emperor Hui he was appointed supernumerary chariot master and progressively promoted heir-apparent household aide and supernumerary irregular cavalry attendant.

units.zh: 成都王穎奔長安，東海王越以模為北中郎將，鎮鄴。
units.en: Ying's flight west left Mo northern gentleman at Ye under Yue.
units.literal: When Prince of Chengdu Ying fled to Chang'an Prince of Donghai Yue appointed Mo Northern Gentlemen General guarding Ye.

units.zh: 永興初，成都王穎故帳下督公師籓、樓權、郝昌等攻鄴，模左右謀應之。
units.en: Yongxing opened with Gongshi Fan's siege and traitors inside Ye.
units.literal: Early Yongxing Chengdu Prince Ying's former overseer Gongshi Fan Lou Quan Hao Chang and others attacked Ye; Mo's attendants plotted to respond within.

units.zh: 廣平太守丁邵率眾救模，范陽王虓又遣兗州刺史苟晞援之，籓等散走。
units.en: Ding Shao and Gou Xi lifted the siege and routed Fan.
units.literal: Guangping governor Ding Shao led hosts relieving Mo; Prince Xiao of Fanyang again dispatched Yan Inspector Gou Xi aiding them; Fan and others scattered and fled.

units.zh: 遷鎮東大將軍，鎮許昌。
units.en: He became guarding-east marshal at Xuchang.
units.literal: Mo was promoted Guarding East Grand Marshal stationed Xuchang.

units.zh: 進爵南陽王。
units.en: Promoted to Prince of Nanyang.
units.literal: He advanced noble rank Prince of Nanyang.

units.zh: 永嘉初，轉征西大將軍、開府、都督秦雍梁益諸軍事，代河間王顒鎮關中。
units.en: Yongjia gave him four-province western command replacing Sima Yong.
units.literal: Early Yongjia he transferred western expedition grand marshal independent headquarters supervising Qin Yong Liang Yi military affairs replacing Prince of Hejian Yong guarding Guanzhong.

units.zh: 模感丁邵之德，敕國人為邵生立碑。
units.en: He memorialized Ding Shao with a standing stone.
units.literal: Mo grateful for Ding Shao's virtue ordered his people erect a living monument to Shao.

units.zh: 時關中饑荒，百姓相噉，加以疾癘，盜賊公行。
units.en: Famine cannibalism plague and brigandage ravaged Guanzhong.
units.literal: At that time Guanzhong starved; commoners devoured one another; pestilence added; bandits operated openly.

units.zh: 模力不能制，乃鑄銅人鐘鼎為釜器以易穀，議者非之。
units.en: He melted ritual bronzes for grain swaps—widely condemned.
units.literal: Mo's strength could not control it so he cast bronze men bells and tripods into cauldrons to trade for grain; critics condemned this.

units.zh: 東海王越表徵模為司空，遣中書監傅祗代之。
units.en: Yue summoned Mo to minister of works under Fu Zhi.
units.literal: Prince of Donghai Yue memorialized summoning Mo as Minister of Works sending Palace Library Director Fu Zhi to replace him.

units.zh: 模謀臣淳於定說模曰：「關中天府之國，霸王之地。
units.en: Mo's strategist Chunyu Ding advised Mo saying 'Guanzhong is heaven's storehouse—the ground of hegemons.
units.literal: Mo's strategist Chunyu Ding advised Mo saying 'Guanzhong is heaven's storehouse—the ground of hegemons.

units.zh: 今以不能綏撫而還，既於聲望有虧，又公兄弟唱起大事，而並在朝廷，若自強則有專權之罪，弱則受制於人，非公之利也。」
units.en: Now unable to soothe and returning damages your renown; moreover your lordship's brothers launched great affairs yet both remain at court—if you strengthen yourself you incur monopolizing guilt; if weak you fall under others' control—not to your advantage.'
units.literal: Now unable to soothe and returning damages your renown; moreover your lordship's brothers launched great affairs yet both remain at court—if you strengthen yourself you incur monopolizing guilt; if weak you fall under others' control—not to your advantage.'

units.zh: 模納其言，不就徵。
units.en: Mo stayed put ignoring the recall.
units.literal: Mo accepted his words and did not obey the summons.

units.zh: 表遣世子保為西中郎將、東羌校尉，鎮上邽，秦州刺史裴苞距之。
units.en: He sent heir Bao to Shanggui against Pei Bao's block.
units.literal: He memorialized dispatching heir-apparent Bao as Western Gentlemen General Eastern Qiang colonel guarding Shanggui; Qin Inspector Pei Bao resisted.

units.zh: 模使帳下都尉陳安率眾攻苞，苞奔安定。
units.en: Chen An drove Pei Bao to Anding.
units.literal: Mo ordered household Commandant Chen An leading hosts attacking Bao; Bao fled Anding.

units.zh: 太守賈疋以郡迎苞，模遣軍司謝班伐疋，疋退盧水。
units.en: Jia Ya's welcome drew Xie Ban until Ya fled to Lushui.
units.literal: Governor Jia Ya of the commandery welcomed Bao with the district; Mo dispatched army director Xie Ban attacking Ya; Ya withdrew to Lushui.

units.zh: 其年，進位太尉、大都督。
units.en: Same year brought grand commandant and supreme command.
units.literal: That year he advanced Grand Commandant grand commander.

units.zh: 洛京傾覆，模使牙門趙染戍蒲阪，染求馮翊太守不得，怒，率眾降于劉聰。
units.en: Luoyang's fall and Zhao Ran's pique handed Liu Cong an opening.
units.literal: When Luoyang collapsed Mo sent gate officer Zhao Ran guarding Puban; Ran sought Fufeng governor unsuccessfully angrily led hosts surrendering to Liu Cong.

units.zh: 聰使其子粲及染攻長安，模使淳於定距之，為染所敗。
units.en: Liu Can and Zhao Ran routed Ding before Chang'an.
units.literal: Cong ordered son Can and Ran attacking Chang'an; Mo sent Chunyu Ding resisting; defeated by Ran.

units.zh: 士眾離叛，倉庫虛竭，軍祭酒韋輔曰：「事急矣，早降可以免。」
units.en: Troops deserted; granaries emptied; army libationer Wei Fu said 'Matters are desperate—early surrender can spare you.'
units.literal: Troops deserted; granaries emptied; army libationer Wei Fu said 'Matters are desperate—early surrender can spare you.'

units.zh: 模從之，遂降於染。
units.en: Mo yielded to Zhao Ran.
units.literal: Mo followed this and thereupon surrendered to Ran.

units.zh: 染箕踞攘袂數模之罪，送詣粲。
units.en: Ran humiliated Mo then handed him to Liu Can.
units.literal: Ran squatted spreading sleeves counting Mo's crimes and sent him to Can.

units.zh: 粲殺之，以模妃劉氏賜胡張本為妻。
units.en: Can executed Mo and gifted his wife to Zhang Ben.
units.literal: Can killed him and gave Mo's consort Lady Liu to Hu Zhang Ben as wife.

units.zh: 子保立。
units.en: Bao inherited.
units.literal: Son Bao succeeded.

units.zh: 保字景度，少有文義，好述作。
units.en: Sima Bao, styled Jingdu, loved letters young.
units.literal: Bao courtesy Jingdu in youth had literary skill loving composition.

units.zh: 初拜南陽國世子。
units.en: First named heir of Nanyang.
units.literal: At first appointed heir of Nanyang state.

units.zh: 模遇害，保在邽上。
units.en: When Mo was killed, Bao was in the Gui area.
units.literal: When Mo was killed, Bao was in the Gui area.

units.zh: 其後賈疋死，裴苞又為張軌所殺，保全有秦州之地，自號大司馬，承制置百官。
units.en: After Ya and Pei Bao fell Bao seized Qin as self-declared grand marshal with full bureaucracy.
units.literal: Later after Jia Ya died and Pei Bao was again killed by Zhang Gui Bao wholly held Qin Province styling himself Grand Marshal under emergency regulations establishing hundred offices.

units.zh: 隴右氐羌並從之，涼州刺史張寔遣使貢獻。
units.en: Longyou tribes rallied; Zhang Shi offered tribute.
units.literal: Di and Qiang of Longyou alike followed him; Liang Inspector Zhang Shi sent envoys tribute.

units.zh: 及湣帝即位，以保為右丞相，加侍中、都督陝西諸軍事。
units.en: Min appointed him right chancellor over Shanxi.
units.literal: When Emperor Min ascended Bao was named right chancellor with additional palace attendant supervising Shanxi military affairs.

units.zh: 尋進位相國。
units.en: Soon ceremonial prime minister followed.
units.literal: Soon advanced ceremonial prime minister.

units.zh: 模之敗也，都尉陳安歸於保，保命統精勇千餘人以討羌，寵遇甚厚。
units.en: Chen An joined Bao and led picked troops against Qiang with royal favor.
units.literal: When Mo was defeated Commandant Chen An joined Bao; Bao ordered him command picked warriors over one thousand against Qiang lavishing favor.

units.zh: 保將張春等疾之，譖安有異志，請除之，保不許。
units.en: Zhang Chun plotted against Chen An; Bao refused.
units.literal: Bao's generals Zhang Chun and others envied him slandering An harboring rebellion requesting execution; Bao forbade.

units.zh: 春等輒伏客以刺安，安被創，馳還隴城，遣使詣保，貢獻不絕。
units.en: Assassins wounded An who kept sending tribute from Longcheng.
units.literal: Chun and others then hid guests stabbing An; An wounded galloped back to Longcheng dispatching envoys to Bao tribute unceasing.

units.zh: 湣帝之蒙塵也，保自稱晉王。
units.en: Min's flight led Bao to claim Jin kingship.
units.literal: When Emperor Min suffered exile Bao styled himself King of Jin.

units.zh: 時上邽大饑，士眾窘困，張春奉保之南安。
units.en: Famine drove Zhang Chun to evacuate Bao toward Nan'an.
units.literal: Then Shanggui greatly starved troops distressed Zhang Chun conducted Bao to Nan'an.

units.zh: 陳安自號秦州刺史，稱籓于劉曜。
units.en: Chen An took Qin title while serving Liu Yao.
units.literal: Chen An styled himself Qin Inspector declaring vassalage to Liu Yao.

units.zh: 春復奉保奔桑城，將投于張寔。
units.en: They aimed for Zhang Shi via Sang.
units.literal: Chun again conducted Bao fleeing Sang castle intending to join Zhang Shi.

units.zh: 寔使兵迎保，實禦之也。
units.en: Zhang Shi's escort meant to intercept him.
units.literal: Shi sent troops welcoming Bao truly to block him.

units.zh: 是歲，保病薨，時年二十七。
units.en: He died ill at twenty-seven.
units.literal: That year Bao died ill age twenty-seven.

units.zh: 保體質豐偉，嘗自稱重八百斤。
units.en: He boasted eight hundred jin bulk.
units.literal: Bao's body was stout; he once claimed weight eight hundred jin.

units.zh: 喜睡，痿疾，不能禦婦人。
units.en: Somnolence and impotence plagued him.
units.literal: He loved sleep suffered wasting illness could not bed women.

units.zh: 無子，張春立宗室司馬瞻奉保後。
units.en: Childless, Zhan continued his house under Zhang Chun.
units.literal: Having no son Zhang Chun established clansman Sima Zhan to continue Bao's offerings.

units.zh: 陳安舉兵攻春，春走，瞻降于安，安送詣劉曜，曜殺之。
units.en: Chen An crushed Zhang Chun and sent Zhan to his death at Liu Yao's court.
units.literal: Chen An raised troops attacking Chun; Chun fled Zhan surrendered to An who delivered him to Liu Yao who executed him.

units.zh: 安迎保喪，以天子禮葬于上邽，諡曰元。
units.en: Chen An buried Bao as emperor with Yuan epithet.
units.literal: An welcomed Bao's coffin burying him at Shanggui by Son of Heaven rites posthumous title Yuan.

units.zh: 范陽康王綏
units.en: Sima Sui, Prince Kang of Fanyang.
units.literal: Prince Kang of Fanyang Sui.

units.zh: 范陽康王綏，字子都，彭城王權季弟也，初為諫議大夫。
units.en: Sima Sui, styled Zidu, was Quan's youngest brother—grand counselor first.
units.literal: Prince Kang of Fanyang Sui courtesy Zidu was youngest brother of Prince Mu of Pengcheng Quan beginning as grand counselor of remonstrance.

units.zh: 泰始元年受封，在位十五年。
units.en: He received enfeoffment in Taishi year one and held the title for fifteen years.
units.literal: He received enfeoffment in Taishi year one and held the title for fifteen years.

units.zh: 咸寧五年薨，子虓立焉。
units.en: He died in Xianning year five, and his son Xiao succeeded him.
units.literal: He died in Xianning year five, and his son Xiao succeeded him.

units.zh: 子虓
units.en: Son Xiao.
units.literal: Son Xiao.

units.zh: 虓字武會，少好學，馳譽，研考經記，清辯，能言論。
units.en: Sima Xiao, styled Wuhui, was a famed scholar-orator.
units.literal: Xiao courtesy Wuhui in youth loved learning riding fame researching classics lucid in debate skilled speech.

units.zh: 以宗室選拜散騎常侍，累遷尚書。
units.en: Clan selection brought cavalry attendant then ministry posts.
units.literal: Chosen from imperial clan appointed irregular cavalry attendant progressively promoted minister of writing.

units.zh: 出為安南將軍、都督豫州諸軍事、持節，鎮許昌，進位征南將軍。
units.en: He commanded Yu from Xuchang southward through pacifying and expedition ranks.
units.literal: He went out Pacifying South General supervising Yu military affairs credential-bearing stationed Xuchang promoted southern expedition general.

units.zh: 河間王顒表立成都王穎為太弟，為王浚所破，挾天子還洛陽。
units.en: Yong's heir plot collapsed under Wang Jun forcing return east.
units.literal: Prince of Hejian Yong memorialized establishing Chengdu Prince Ying heir-apparent; defeated by Wang Jun he escorted Son of Heaven back Luoyang.

units.zh: 虓與東平王楙、鎮東將軍周馥等上言曰：自湣懷被害，皇儲不建，委重前相，輒失臣節。
units.en: Xiao, together with King Mao of Dongping, General Who Guards the East Zhou Fu, and others, submitted words, saying: Since Minhuai was harmed, the imperial heir has not been established. Weighty responsibility was entrusted to the former minister, and he then lost the duty of a subject.
units.literal: Xiao, together with King Mao of Dongping, General Who Guards the East Zhou Fu, and others, submitted words, saying: Since Minhuai was harmed, the imperial heir has not been established. Weighty responsibility was entrusted to the former minister, and he then lost the duty of a subject.

units.zh: 是以前年太宰與臣，永惟社稷之貳，不可久空，所以共啟成都王穎，以為國副。
units.en: Therefore in the previous year the Grand Steward and we your servants long considered that the deputy of the altars of soil and grain could not remain vacant for long, and for this reason we jointly proposed King Ying of Chengdu to be deputy to the state.
units.literal: Therefore in the previous year the Grand Steward and we your servants long considered that the deputy of the altars of soil and grain could not remain vacant for long, and for this reason we jointly proposed King Ying of Chengdu to be deputy to the state.

units.zh: 受重之後，而弗克負荷。
units.en: After receiving this weighty charge, he was unable to bear it.
units.literal: After receiving this weighty charge, he was unable to bear it.

units.zh: 「小人勿用」，而以為腹心。
units.en: "Do not employ petty men," yet he made them his trusted intimates.
units.literal: "Do not employ petty men," yet he made them his trusted intimates.

units.zh: 骨肉宜敦，而猜佻薦至，險詖宜遠，而讒說殄行。
units.en: Flesh-and-blood kin should have been treated with thick affection, yet suspicion and frivolity arrived repeatedly; dangerous and slanting men should have been kept distant, yet slanderous talk destroyed conduct.
units.literal: Flesh-and-blood kin should have been treated with thick affection, yet suspicion and frivolity arrived repeatedly; dangerous and slanting men should have been kept distant, yet slanderous talk destroyed conduct.

units.zh: 此皆臣等不聰不明，失所宗賴。
units.en: All this was because we your servants were neither perceptive nor clear-sighted and lost the one on whom we relied.
units.literal: All this was because we your servants were neither perceptive nor clear-sighted and lost the one on whom we relied.

units.zh: 遂令陛下謬于降授，雖戮臣等，不足以謝天下。
units.en: We then caused Your Majesty to err in lowering and granting rank; even if you executed us, it would not be enough to apologize to all under Heaven.
units.literal: We then caused Your Majesty to err in lowering and granting rank; even if you executed us, it would not be enough to apologize to all under Heaven.

units.zh: 今大駕還宮，文武空曠，制度荒破，靡有孑遺，臣等雖劣，足匡王室。
units.en: Now the great carriage has returned to the palace, civil and military offices are empty, institutions are ruined and broken, and nothing remains. Although we your servants are inferior, we are enough to help correct the royal house.
units.literal: Now the great carriage has returned to the palace, civil and military offices are empty, institutions are ruined and broken, and nothing remains. Although we your servants are inferior, we are enough to help correct the royal house.

units.zh: 而道路之言，謂張方與臣等不同。
units.en: But talk on the roads says that Zhang Fang is not of one mind with us.
units.literal: But talk on the roads says that Zhang Fang is not of one mind with us.

units.zh: 既惜所在興異，又乙太宰惇德允元，著於具瞻，每當義節，輒為社稷宗盟之先。
units.en: We both regret that differences are arising where he is, and also because the Grand Steward is sincere in virtue and truly principal, visible to all who look up to him; whenever righteousness and integrity are at stake, he always stands first among the great allies of the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: We both regret that differences are arising where he is, and also because the Grand Steward is sincere in virtue and truly principal, visible to all who look up to him; whenever righteousness and integrity are at stake, he always stands first among the great allies of the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 張方受其指教，為國效節。
units.en: Zhang Fang received his direction and instruction and showed integrity for the state.
units.literal: Zhang Fang received his direction and instruction and showed integrity for the state.

units.zh: 昔年之舉，有死無貳。
units.en: In last year's action, he had death before him and no second loyalty.
units.literal: In last year's action, he had death before him and no second loyalty.

units.zh: 此即太宰之良將，陛下之忠臣。
units.en: He is therefore a good general of the Grand Steward and a loyal subject of Your Majesty.
units.literal: He is therefore a good general of the Grand Steward and a loyal subject of Your Majesty.

units.zh: 但以受性強毅，不達變通，遂守前志，已致紛紜。
units.en: It is only because his nature is forceful and resolute and he does not understand adaptation that he kept to his former intention and has already caused confusion.
units.literal: It is only because his nature is forceful and resolute and he does not understand adaptation that he kept to his former intention and has already caused confusion.

units.zh: 然退思惟，既是其不易之節，且慮事翻之後，為天下所罪，故不即西還耳。
units.en: Yet when we withdraw and think on it, this is already his unchanging integrity, and he also worries that after affairs reverse, he will be blamed by all under Heaven; therefore he has not immediately returned west.
units.literal: Yet when we withdraw and think on it, this is already his unchanging integrity, and he also worries that after affairs reverse, he will be blamed by all under Heaven; therefore he has not immediately returned west.

units.zh: 原其本事，實無深責。
units.en: When the root of the matter is traced, there is in fact no deep blame.
units.literal: When the root of the matter is traced, there is in fact no deep blame.

units.zh: 臣聞先代明主，未嘗不全護功臣，令福流子孫。
units.en: We your servants have heard that enlightened rulers of earlier generations always preserved and protected meritorious ministers and made blessings flow to their descendants.
units.literal: We your servants have heard that enlightened rulers of earlier generations always preserved and protected meritorious ministers and made blessings flow to their descendants.

units.zh: 自中間以來，陛下功臣初無全者，非獨人才皆劣，其於取禍，實由朝廷策之失宜，不相容恕。
units.en: Since the recent troubled period, none of Your Majesty's meritorious ministers has been preserved. This is not only because the men were all inferior; their incurring disaster has truly come from the court's policies losing what was fitting and from failure to tolerate and forgive one another.
units.literal: Since the recent troubled period, none of Your Majesty's meritorious ministers has been preserved. This is not only because the men were all inferior; their incurring disaster has truly come from the court's policies losing what was fitting and from failure to tolerate and forgive one another.

units.zh: 以一旦之咎，喪其積年之勳，既違《周禮》議功之典，且使天下之人莫敢復為陛下致節者。
units.en: To lose accumulated years of merit because of one day's fault both violates the Zhouli canon of deliberating on merit and makes the people of the realm no longer dare to give their utmost loyalty for Your Majesty.
units.literal: To lose accumulated years of merit because of one day's fault both violates the Zhouli canon of deliberating on merit and makes the people of the realm no longer dare to give their utmost loyalty for Your Majesty.

units.zh: 臣等此言，豈獨為一張方，實為社稷遠計，欲令功臣長守富貴。
units.en: These words of ours are not only for one Zhang Fang; they are truly a long-range plan for the altars of soil and grain, wishing to let meritorious ministers long keep wealth and honor.
units.literal: These words of ours are not only for one Zhang Fang; they are truly a long-range plan for the altars of soil and grain, wishing to let meritorious ministers long keep wealth and honor.

units.zh: 臣愚以為宜委太宰以關右之任，一方事重，及自州郡已下，選舉授任，一皆仰成。
units.en: In our foolish view, it is fitting to entrust the Grand Steward with responsibility west of the passes. Affairs in that region are weighty, and from provinces and commanderies downward, selection, recommendation, appointment, and assignment should all look up to him for completion.
units.literal: In our foolish view, it is fitting to entrust the Grand Steward with responsibility west of the passes. Affairs in that region are weighty, and from provinces and commanderies downward, selection, recommendation, appointment, and assignment should all look up to him for completion.

units.zh: 若朝之大事，廢興損益，每輒疇諮。
units.en: As for great affairs of the court, abolitions, establishments, reductions, and additions, each should be consulted with him.
units.literal: As for great affairs of the court, abolitions, establishments, reductions, and additions, each should be consulted with him.

units.zh: 此則二伯述職，周召分陝之義，陛下復行於今時。
units.en: This would be Your Majesty carrying out again in the present age the meaning of the two regional chiefs reporting on their duties and of Zhou and Shao dividing Shaan.
units.literal: This would be Your Majesty carrying out again in the present age the meaning of the two regional chiefs reporting on their duties and of Zhou and Shao dividing Shaan.

units.zh: 遣方還郡，令群後申志，時定王室。
units.en: Send Fang back to his commandery, let the assembled nobles extend their intentions, and in time settle the royal house.
units.literal: Send Fang back to his commandery, let the assembled nobles extend their intentions, and in time settle the royal house.

units.zh: 所加方官，請悉如舊。
units.en: As for the offices added to Fang, we request that all be as before.
units.literal: As for the offices added to Fang, we request that all be as before.

units.zh: 此則忠臣義士有勸，功臣必全矣。
units.en: Then loyal ministers and righteous men will have encouragement, and meritorious ministers will surely be preserved.
units.literal: Then loyal ministers and righteous men will have encouragement, and meritorious ministers will surely be preserved.

units.zh: 司徒戎，異姓之賢；
units.en: Minister over the Masses Rong is a worthy of a different surname.
units.literal: Minister over the Masses Rong is a worthy of a different surname.

units.zh: 司空越，公族之望，並忠國愛主，小心翼翼，宜幹機事，委以朝政。
units.en: Minister of Works Yue is the hope of the imperial clan. Both are loyal to the state and love the ruler, careful and reverent, and should manage key affairs and be entrusted with court government.
units.literal: Minister of Works Yue is the hope of the imperial clan. Both are loyal to the state and love the ruler, careful and reverent, and should manage key affairs and be entrusted with court government.

units.zh: 安北將軍王浚佐命之胤，率身履道，忠亮清正，遠近所推。
units.en: General Who Pacifies the North Wang Jun is a descendant of one who assisted the mandate; he leads himself according to the Way, is loyal, bright, clear, and correct, and is recommended by those near and far.
units.literal: General Who Pacifies the North Wang Jun is a descendant of one who assisted the mandate; he leads himself according to the Way, is loyal, bright, clear, and correct, and is recommended by those near and far.

units.zh: 如今日之大舉，實有定社稷之勳，此是臣等所以歎息歸高也。
units.en: In a great undertaking like today's, he truly has merit in settling the altars of soil and grain; this is why we sigh in admiration and return high praise to him.
units.literal: In a great undertaking like today's, he truly has merit in settling the altars of soil and grain; this is why we sigh in admiration and return high praise to him.

units.zh: 浚宜特崇重之，以副群望，遂撫幽朔，長為北籓。
units.en: Jun should be specially exalted and honored in order to meet the hopes of the multitude, then pacify You and the northern lands and long serve as the northern shield.
units.literal: Jun should be specially exalted and honored in order to meet the hopes of the multitude, then pacify You and the northern lands and long serve as the northern shield.

units.zh: 臣等竭力扞城，籓屏皇家，陛下垂拱，而四海自正。
units.en: We your servants will exhaust our strength as defending walls and act as screens for the imperial house, while Your Majesty lets your robes hang and folds your hands, and the four seas will correct themselves.
units.literal: We your servants will exhaust our strength as defending walls and act as screens for the imperial house, while Your Majesty lets your robes hang and folds your hands, and the four seas will correct themselves.

units.zh: 則四祖之業，必隆於今，日月之暉，昧而復曜。
units.en: Then the enterprise of the Four Ancestors will surely flourish today, and the radiance of sun and moon, once dimmed, will shine again.
units.literal: Then the enterprise of the Four Ancestors will surely flourish today, and the radiance of sun and moon, once dimmed, will shine again.

units.zh: 乞垂三思，察臣所言。
units.en: We beg you to lower threefold thought and examine what we your servants have said.
units.literal: We beg you to lower threefold thought and examine what we your servants have said.

units.zh: 又可以臣表西示太宰。
units.en: You may also show our memorial westward to the Grand Steward.
units.literal: You may also show our memorial westward to the Grand Steward.

units.zh: 又表曰：「成都王失道，為奸邪所誤，論王之身，不宜深責。
units.en: Again memorializing 'Chengdu Prince lost the Way misled by wicked favorites judging the prince's person ought not be deeply blamed.
units.literal: Again memorializing 'Chengdu Prince lost the Way misled by wicked favorites judging the prince's person ought not be deeply blamed.

units.zh: 且先帝遺體，陛下群弟，自元康以來，罪戮相等，實海內所為匈匈，而臣等所以痛心。
units.en: Moreover former emperor's bodily heirs Your Majesty's junior brothers since Yuankang executions match in toll truly why realm churns and why we ache.
units.literal: Moreover former emperor's bodily heirs Your Majesty's junior brothers since Yuankang executions match in toll truly why realm churns and why we ache.

units.zh: 今廢成都，更封一邑，宜其必許。
units.en: Now deposing Chengdu changing enfeoffment one canton he ought surely consent.
units.literal: Now deposing Chengdu changing enfeoffment one canton he ought surely consent.

units.zh: 若廢黜尋有禍害，既傷陛下矜慈之恩，又令遠近恆謂公族無復骨肉之情，此實臣等內省悲慚，無顏于四海也。
units.en: If deposition soon brings calamity it wounds Your Majesty's compassionate grace and lets far and near forever say the ducal kin lack flesh-and-blood feeling—truly our inward shame without face before the realm.
units.literal: If deposition soon brings calamity it wounds Your Majesty's compassionate grace and lets far and near forever say the ducal kin lack flesh-and-blood feeling—truly our inward shame without face before the realm.

units.zh: 乞陛下察臣忠款。」
units.en: We beg Your Majesty to perceive our loyal sincerity."
units.literal: We beg Your Majesty to perceive our loyal sincerity."

units.zh: 於是虓先率眾自許屯于滎陽。
units.en: Xiao marched to Xingyang first.
units.literal: Thereupon Xiao first led hosts from Xu camping at Xingyang.

units.zh: 會惠帝西遷，虓與從兄平昌公模、長史馮嵩等刑白馬喢血而盟，推東海王越為盟主，虓都督河北諸軍事、驃騎將軍、持節，領豫州刺史。
units.en: Western flight triggered blood pact naming Yue leader with Xiao commanding Hebei and Yu.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui moved west Xiao together with cousin Pingchang duke Mo chief clerk Feng Song slaughtered white horse smearing blood in covenant elevating Prince of Donghai Yue covenant lord; Xiao supervised Hebei military affairs champion general credential-bearing concurrent Yu Inspector.

units.zh: 劉喬不受越等節度，乘虛破許。
units.en: Liu Qiao seized Xu defying Yue.
units.literal: Liu Qiao refused obeying Yue and others exploiting emptiness broke Xu.

units.zh: 虓自拔渡河，王浚表虓領翼州刺史，資以兵馬。
units.en: Wang Jun backed Xiao as Ji commander with materiel.
units.literal: Xiao extricated himself crossing the river; Wang Jun memorialized Xiao commanding Ji Inspector supplying troops and horses.

units.zh: 虓入翼州發兵，又南濟河，破喬等。
units.en: Xiao rallied Ji forces and crushed Liu Qiao south of the river.
units.literal: Xiao entered Ji Province raising troops again crossing south the river defeating Qiao and others.

units.zh: 河間王顒聞喬敗，斬張方，傳首於越。
units.en: Yong killed Zhang Fang after Qiao's defeat.
units.literal: Prince Yong hearing Qiao defeated executed Zhang Fang sending head to Yue.

units.zh: 越與虓西迎帝，而顒出奔。
units.en: Yue and Xiao went west to meet Emperor Hui, while Yong fled.
units.literal: Yue together with Xiao west welcoming emperor while Yong fled.

units.zh: 於是奉天子還都，拜虓為司徒。
units.en: They restored Luoyang naming Xiao minister of education.
units.literal: Thereupon elevating Son of Heaven restoring capital Xiao was appointed Minister of Education.

units.zh: 永興三年暴疾薨，時年三十七。
units.en: In the third year of Yongxing, he died suddenly at thirty-seven.
units.literal: In the third year of Yongxing, Sudden illness died age thirty-seven.

units.zh: 無子，養模子黎為嗣，黎隨模就國，于長安遇害。
units.en: Childless Li continued Mo's line and died at Chang'an.
units.literal: Having no sons he adopted Mo's son Li successor; Li followed Mo to state harmed at Chang'an.

units.zh: 濟南惠王遂
units.en: Sima Sui, Prince Hui of Jinan.
units.literal: Prince Hui of Jinan Sui.

units.zh: 濟南惠王遂，字子伯，宣帝弟魏鴻臚丞恂之子也。
units.en: Sima Sui, styled Zibo, was Sima Xun's son—Sima Yi's nephew.
units.literal: Prince Hui of Jinan Sui courtesy Zibo was son of Emperor Xuan's younger brother Wei Grand Herald Assistant Xun.

units.zh: 仕魏關內侯，進封平昌亭侯，曆典軍郎將，
units.en: Under Wei he rose from secondary marquis to Pingchang ting through army posts.
units.literal: Serving Wei district marquis within passes advanced Marquis of Pingchang precinct successively holding army corps captain.

units.zh: 景元二年，轉封武城鄉侯、督鄴城守諸軍事、北中郎將。
units.en: In the second year of Jingyuan, Shifted to Wucheng township marquis guarding Ye as northern gentleman.
units.literal: In the second year of Jingyuan, Transferred enfeoffment Wucheng village marquis supervising Ye garrison Northern Gentlemen General.

units.zh: 五等建，封祝阿伯，累遷冠軍將軍。
units.en: Five-rank reform made him Zhu'e baron then champion general.
units.literal: When five ranks were established enfeoffed Baron of Zhu'e progressively Champion General.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封濟南王。
units.en: Sima Yan created Jinan prince.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Jinan.

units.zh: 泰始二年薨。
units.en: He died in the second year of Taishi.
units.literal: In the second year of Taishi, he died.

units.zh: 二子：耽、緝。
units.en: Sons Dan and Ji.
units.literal: Two sons: Dan and Ji.

units.zh: 耽嗣立，咸寧三年徙為中山王。
units.en: Dan succeeded to the title, and in Xianning year three he was transferred to be Prince of Zhongshan.
units.literal: Dan succeeded to the title, and in Xianning year three he was transferred to be Prince of Zhongshan.

units.zh: 是年薨，無子，緝繼。
units.en: Dan died childless same year; Ji followed.
units.literal: Same year died without sons Ji continued.

units.zh: 成都王穎以緝為建威將軍，與石熙等率眾距王浚，沒於陣，薨。
units.en: Ying named Ji bulwark general alongside Shi Xi to stop Wang Jun; Ji died on the field.
units.literal: Prince of Chengdu Ying appointed Ji bulwark general leading hosts with Shi Xi resisting Wang Jun perishing in battle.

units.zh: 無子，國除。
units.en: Without heirs the principality ended.
units.literal: Having no sons state abolished.

units.zh: 曾孫勳
units.en: Great-grandson Xun.
units.literal: Great-grandson Xun.

units.zh: 後遂之曾孫勳字偉長，年十餘歲，湣帝末，長安陷，劉曜將令狐泥養為子。
units.en: Linghu Ni adopted young Xun after Chang'an fell.
units.literal: Later Sui's great-grandson Xun courtesy Weichang age over ten at Emperor Min's end Chang'an fell Liu Yao general Linghu Ni raised him as son.

units.zh: 及壯，便弓馬，能左右射，，自關右還，自列云「是大長秋恂之玄孫，冠軍將軍濟南惠王遂之曾孫，略陽太守瓘之子」，遂拜謁者僕射，以勇聞。
units.en: Reaching adulthood skilled horse archery shooting both hands returning from west of the pass self-listed saying 'I am senior palace attendant Xun's great-great-grandson champion general Prince Hui of Jinan Sui's great-grandson governor of Lueyang Guan's son' thereupon appointed Herald Superintendent famed courage.
units.literal: Reaching adulthood skilled horse archery shooting both hands returning from west of the pass self-listed saying 'I am senior palace attendant Xun's great-great-grandson champion general Prince Hui of Jinan Sui's great-grandson governor of Lueyang Guan's son' thereupon appointed Herald Superintendent famed courage.

units.zh: 庾翼之鎮襄陽，以梁州刺史援桓宣卒，請勳代之。
units.en: Yu Yi at Xiangyang asked Xun to fill the Liang post vacated by aide Huan Xuan's death.
units.literal: When Yu Yi garrisoned Xiangyang because the Liang Inspector's aide Huan Xuan died he requested Xun replace him.

units.zh: 初屯西城，退守武當。
units.en: He first garrisoned the west town then pulled back to Wudang.
units.literal: At first encamped western citadel withdrew guarding Wudang.

units.zh: 時石季龍死，中國亂，雍州諸豪帥馳告勳。
units.en: Shi Hu's death unraveled the north; Yongzhou strongmen raced word to Sima Xun.
units.literal: At that time Shi Jilong died central plains chaotic Yongzhou magnates galloped informing Xun.

units.zh: 勳率眾出駱谷，壁於懸鉤，去長安二百里，遣部將劉煥攻長安，又拔賀城。
units.en: He crossed Luogu, camped near Chang'an, sent Liu Huan to raid the capital and took Hecheng.
units.literal: Xun led hosts exiting Luogu valley fortifying Xuāngou two hundred li from Chang'an dispatching subordinate Liu Huan attacking Chang'an again capturing Hecheng.

units.zh: 於是關中皆殺季龍太守令長以應勳。
units.en: All Guanzhong slew Hu's officials to rally to Xun.
units.literal: Thereupon Guanzhong altogether killed Shi Hu's governors magistrates and commandants responding to Xun.

units.zh: 勳兵少，未能自固，復還梁州。
units.en: Too weak to hold ground he retreated to Liangzhou.
units.literal: Xun's troops were few unable to secure himself returning again Liang Province.

units.zh: 永和中，張琚據隴東，遣使召勳，勳復入長安。
units.en: Zhang Ju's eastern Long grip drew Xun back into Chang'an.
units.literal: In Yonghe middle years Zhang Ju occupied Long east dispatching envoys summoning Xun; Xun again entered Chang'an.

units.zh: 初，京兆人杜洪以豪族陵琚，琚以勇俠侮洪，洪知勳憚琚兵強，因說勳曰；
units.en: Du Hong and Zhang Ju feuded; Hong played on Xun's fear of Ju's strength:
units.literal: At first Jingzhao man Du Hong by powerful clan oppressed Ju; Ju by bold fellowship insulted Hong; Hong knew Xun feared Ju's strong troops therefore persuaded Xun saying

units.zh: 「不殺張琚，關中非國家有也。」
units.en: "If you do not kill Zhang Ju, Guanzhong will not belong to the state."
units.literal: "If you do not kill Zhang Ju, Guanzhong will not belong to the state."

units.zh: 勳乃偽請琚，於坐殺之。
units.en: Xun feasted Ju and slew him at table.
units.literal: Xun then falsely invited Ju killing him seated.

units.zh: 琚弟走池陽，合眾攻勳，頻戰不利，請和，歸梁州。
units.en: Ju's brother rallied from Chiyang, fought Xun to stalemate, then sued for peace back in Liang.
units.literal: Ju's younger brother fled Chiyang gathering hosts attacking Xun frequent battles unfavorable requesting peace returning Liang Province.

units.zh: 後桓溫伐關中，命勳出子午道，而為苻雄所敗，退屯於女媧堡。
units.en: Huan Wen's operation sent Xun up Ziwu until Fu Xiong broke him at Nüwa.
units.literal: Later Huan Wen campaigned Guanzhong ordering Xun exit Ziwu road but was defeated by Fu Xiong withdrawing encamped at Nüwa fortress.

units.zh: 俄遷征虜將軍，監關中軍事，領西戎校尉，賜爵通吉亭侯。
units.en: Promotion brought subduing-captive rank, Guanzhong oversight, tribal colonel, and Tongji ting.
units.literal: Soon promoted general Who Subdues Captives supervising Guanzhong military affairs concurrent western tribes colonel enfeoffed Marquis of Tongji precinct.

units.zh: 為政暴酷，至於治中別駕及州之豪右，言語忤意，即於坐梟斬之，或引弓自射。
units.en: He executed aides and notables on whim, sometimes with his own bow.
units.literal: His governance was violent-cruel reaching assistants regional aides and provincial magnates—speech offending intent meant immediate execution seated or drawing bow personally shooting.

units.zh: 西土患其凶虐。
units.en: The west dreaded his savagery.
units.literal: Western lands suffered his fierce cruelty.

units.zh: 在州常懷據蜀，有僭偽之意。
units.en: He eyed Yi Province for a throne of his own.
units.literal: In province he constantly harbored occupying Shu intent usurping pretension.

units.zh: 桓溫聞之，務相綏懷，以其子康為漢中太守。
units.en: Huan Wen placated him naming Kang Hanzhong shepherd.
units.literal: Huan Wen hearing this diligently soothed appointing his son Kang Hanzhong governor.

units.zh: 勳逆謀已成，憚益州刺史周撫，未發。
units.en: Plot ready, he hesitated while Zhou Fu lived.
units.literal: Xun's rebellion scheme already formed feared Yi Inspector Zhou Fu not launching.

units.zh: 及撫卒，遂擁眾入劍閣。
units.en: Fu's death opened Jiange to his army.
units.literal: When Fu died he then gathered hosts entering Jiange.

units.zh: 梁州別駕雍端、西戎司馬隗粹並切諫，勳皆誅之，自號梁益二州牧、成都王。
units.en: He murdered remonstrators and proclaimed himself dual shepherd and Chengdu king.
units.literal: Liang Province aide Yong Duan western tribes major Wei Cui together urgently remonstrated Xun executing both styling himself Liang-Yi dual shepherd Chengdu king.

units.zh: 桓溫遣硃序討勳，勳兵潰，為序所獲，及息隴子、長史梁憚、司馬金壹等送于溫，並斬之，傳首京師。
units.en: Zhu Xu crushed him and sent his severed head east with kin and staff.
units.literal: Huan Wen dispatched Zhu Xu punishing Xun; Xun's army collapsed captured by Xu together with heir Longzi chief clerk Liang Dan major Jin Yi and others sent to Wen all beheaded heads transmitted capital.

units.zh: 譙剛王遜
units.en: Sima Xun, Prince Gang of Qiao.
units.literal: Prince Gang of Qiao Xun.

units.zh: 譙剛王遜，字子悌，宣帝弟魏中郎進之子也。
units.en: Sima Xun, styled Ziti, was the son of Sima Jin, Sima Yi's younger brother.
units.literal: Prince Gang of Qiao Xun courtesy Ziti was son of Sima Jin—Emperor Xuan's younger brother who served Wei as gentleman of the palace.

units.zh: 仕魏關內侯，改封城陽亭侯，參鎮東軍事，拜輕車將軍、羽林左監。
units.en: Under Wei he rose through marquis ranks to light-chariot general and guard superintendent on the eastern army staff.
units.literal: Serving Wei he held district marquis within the passes, was reassigned marquis of Chengyang precinct, joined the eastern garrison staff, and was appointed general of light chariots and left superintendent of the imperial guard.

units.zh: 五等建，徙封涇陽男。
units.en: Five ranks moved him to Jingyang baron.
units.literal: When five ranks established transferred enfeoffment Jingyang baron.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，封譙王，邑四千四百戶。
units.en: Sima Yan made him prince of Qiao at 4,400 households.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication enfeoffed Prince of Qiao four thousand four hundred households.

units.zh: 泰始二年薨。
units.en: He died in the second year of Taishi.
units.literal: In the second year of Taishi, he died.

units.zh: 二子：隨、承。
units.en: Sons Sui and Cheng.
units.literal: Two sons: Sui and Cheng.

units.zh: 定王隨立。
units.en: Prince Ding Sima Sui inherited.
units.literal: Prince Ding Sui succeeded.

units.zh: 薨，子邃立，沒于石勒，元帝以承嗣遜。
units.en: When the heir was lost to Shi Le, Sima Rui transferred the succession to Sima Cheng.
units.literal: He died; his heir succeeded but fell captive to Shi Le, so Yuan Di appointed Cheng to continue Xun's line.

units.zh: 子閔王承
units.en: Prince Min Sima Cheng.
units.literal: Son Prince Min Cheng.

units.zh: 閔王承字敬才，少篤厚有志行。
units.en: Sima Cheng, styled Jingcai, was steadfast and purposeful young.
units.literal: Prince Min Cheng courtesy Jingcai youth sincere generous having aspiration conduct.

units.zh: 拜奉車都尉、奉朝請，稍遷廣威將軍、安夷護軍，鎮安定。
units.en: He rose from chariot commandant to display-might rank guarding Anding.
units.literal: Appointed Commandant of Palace Chariots court attendant gradually promoted general Who Displays Might barbarian-protecting general guarding Anding.

units.zh: 從惠帝還洛陽，拜遊擊將軍。
units.en: He accompanied Hui east as roving-strike general.
units.literal: Following Emperor Hui returning Luoyang appointed roving-strike general.

units.zh: 永嘉中，天下漸亂，間行依征南將軍山簡，會簡卒，進至武昌。
units.en: Yongjia turmoil sent him toward Shan Jian then alone to Wuchang.
units.literal: Middle Yongjia realm gradually chaotic traveling stealth relying southern expedition general Shan Jian meeting Jian dying advanced to Wuchang.

units.zh: 元帝初鎮揚州，承歸建康，補軍諮祭酒。
units.en: Sima Rui's Yangzhou command brought Cheng to Jiankang as army adviser.
units.literal: When Yuan Di first garrisoned Yangzhou Cheng returned Jiankang supplemented army advisory libationer.

units.zh: 湣帝徵為龍驤將軍，不行。
units.en: Min's dragon-leaping summons went unanswered.
units.literal: Emperor Min summoned dragon-leaping general did not go.

units.zh: 元帝為晉王，承制更封承為譙王。
units.en: As Jin prince Rui re-created Cheng prince of Qiao.
units.literal: When Yuan Di was Jin prince under emergency regulations re-enfeoffed Cheng Prince of Qiao.

units.zh: 太興初，拜屯騎校尉，加輔國將軍，領左軍將軍。
units.en: Taixing opened with camp-cavalry colonel, bulwark rank, and left army command.
units.literal: Early Taixing appointed colonel of camp cavalry additional bulwark general concurrent left army general.

units.zh: 承居官儉約，家無別室。
units.en: Frugal in office he kept no side rooms.
units.literal: Cheng holding office frugal household lacked separate chamber.

units.zh: 尋加散騎常侍，輔國、左軍如故。
units.en: Soon supernumerary cavalry attendant while keeping bulwark and left army posts.
units.literal: Soon added irregular cavalry attendant bulwark left army as before.

units.zh: 王敦有無君之心，表疏輕慢。
units.en: Wang Dun's memorials showed contempt for the throne.
units.literal: Wang Dun harbored lack-regard-for-lord mind memorials contemptuous.

units.zh: 帝夜召承，以敦表示之，曰：「王敦頃年位任足矣，而所求不已，言至於此，將若之何？」
units.en: Emperor night summoned Cheng showing Dun memorial saying 'Wang Dun recent years position duty suffices yet demands without cease speech reaching here—what shall be done?'
units.literal: Emperor night summoned Cheng showing Dun memorial saying 'Wang Dun recent years position duty suffices yet demands without cease speech reaching here—what shall be done?'

units.zh: 承曰：「陛下不早裁之，難將作矣。」
units.en: Cheng said 'If Your Majesty does not early cut him disaster will arise.'
units.literal: Cheng said 'If Your Majesty does not early cut him disaster will arise.'

units.zh: 帝欲樹籓屏，會敦表以宣城內史沈充為湘州，帝謂承曰：「湘州南楚險固，在上流之要，控三州之會，是用武之國也。
units.en: Emperor wished to plant screens meeting Dun memorial appointing Xuancheng interior governor Shen Chong Xiangzhou emperor told Cheng 'Xiangzhou south Chu peril-firm at upper stream's vital controlling three provinces' convergence is country where arms apply.
units.literal: Emperor wished to plant screens meeting Dun memorial appointing Xuancheng interior governor Shen Chong Xiangzhou emperor told Cheng 'Xiangzhou south Chu peril-firm at upper stream's vital controlling three provinces' convergence is country where arms apply.

units.zh: 今以叔父居之，何如？」
units.en: Now assigning uncle to dwell there—how about it?'
units.literal: Now assigning uncle to dwell there—how about it?'

units.zh: 承曰：「臣幸托末屬，身當宿衛，未有驅馳之勞，頻受過厚之遇，夙夜自厲，思報天德。
units.en: Cheng said 'Your servant luckily leaning on lowest branch body answering night guard lacking rushing labor repeatedly receiving excessive favor morning evening self-sharpening thinking repaying heaven's virtue.
units.literal: Cheng said 'Your servant luckily leaning on lowest branch body answering night guard lacking rushing labor repeatedly receiving excessive favor morning evening self-sharpening thinking repaying heaven's virtue.

units.zh: 君之所命，惟力是視，敢有辭焉！
units.en: What lord commands only strength is regarded—dare there be declining!
units.literal: What lord commands only strength is regarded—dare there be declining!

units.zh: 然湘州蜀寇之餘，人物凋盡，若上憑天威，得之所蒞，比及三年，請從戎役。
units.en: Yet Xiangzhou after Shu bandits' remnant persons things withered if above relying heavenly awe obtaining what descends compared reaching three years please follow martial service.
units.literal: Yet Xiangzhou after Shu bandits' remnant persons things withered if above relying heavenly awe obtaining what descends compared reaching three years please follow martial service.

units.zh: 若未及此，雖復灰身，亦無益也。」
units.en: If this cannot be achieved, then even reducing my body to ashes would be of no benefit."
units.literal: If this cannot be achieved, then even reducing my body to ashes would be of no benefit."

units.zh: 於是詔曰：「夫王者體天理物，非群才不足濟其務。
units.en: Thereupon edict said 'Now kings embody heaven regulating things—without host of talents insufficient to accomplish their tasks.
units.literal: Thereupon edict said 'Now kings embody heaven regulating things—without host of talents insufficient to accomplish their tasks.

units.zh: 外建賢哲，以樹風聲，內睦親親，以廣籓屏。
units.en: Abroad, establish worthy and wise men to raise the court's reputation; within, harmonize with close kin to broaden the protective screens.
units.literal: Abroad, establish worthy and wise men to raise the court's reputation; within, harmonize with close kin to broaden the protective screens.

units.zh: 是以太公封齊，伯禽居魯，此先王之令典，古今之通義也。
units.en: That is why the Grand Duke was enfeoffed in Qi and Boqin held Lu: these were the good institutions of the former kings and a principle recognized in ancient and modern times alike.
units.literal: Therefore the Grand Duke was enfeoffed in Qi, and Boqin occupied Lu; this is the good ordinance of the former kings, a principle common to antiquity and the present.

units.zh: 我晉開基，列國相望，乃授琅邪武王，鎮統東夏；
units.en: Our Jin opened foundation feudal states gazing one another—thereupon invested Prince Langye Wu commanding east Xia.
units.literal: Our Jin opened foundation feudal states gazing one another—thereupon invested Prince Langye Wu commanding east Xia.

units.zh: 汝南文成，總一淮許；
units.en: Runan Wencheng summed Huai Xu.
units.literal: Runan Wencheng summed Huai Xu.

units.zh: 扶風、梁王，迭據關右；
units.en: Fufeng Liang princes alternately held Guanzhong.
units.literal: Fufeng Liang princes alternately held Guanzhong.

units.zh: 爰暨東嬴，作司并州。
units.en: Down to Dongying served as Bingzhou steward.
units.literal: Down to Dongying served as Bingzhou steward.

units.zh: 今公族雖寡，不逮曩時，豈得替舊章乎！
units.en: Now ducal kin though sparse not matching former times—how can we abolish old regulations!
units.literal: Now ducal kin though sparse not matching former times—how can we abolish old regulations!

units.zh: 散騎常侍、左將軍、譙王承貞素款亮，志存忠恪，便蕃左右，恭肅彌著。

units.zh: 今以承監湘州諸軍事、南中郎將、湘州刺史。」
units.en: Now appoint Cheng supervisor Xiangzhou military affairs southern gentlemen general Xiang Inspector.'
units.literal: Now appoint Cheng supervisor Xiangzhou military affairs southern gentlemen general Xiang Inspector.'

units.zh: 初，劉隗以王敦威權太盛，終不可制，勸帝出諸心腹，以鎮方隅。
units.en: Liu Wei had pressed Rui to plant loyal governors against Dun.
units.literal: At first Liu Wei because Wang Dun awesome power too excessive ultimately uncontrollable urged emperor dispatch trusted hearts guarding quarters.

units.zh: 故先以承為湘州，續用隗及戴若思等，並為州牧。
units.en: Cheng headed the scheme alongside Wei and Dai as regional bulwarks.
units.literal: Therefore first appointed Cheng Xiangzhou continuing employing Wei and Dai Ruosi and others altogether shepherds.

units.zh: 承行達武昌，釋戎備見王敦。
units.en: He reached Wuchang unarmed to meet Dun.
units.literal: Cheng traveling reached Wuchang shedding armor visiting Wang Dun.

units.zh: 敦與之宴，欲觀其意，謂承曰：「大王雅素佳士，恐非將帥才也。」
units.en: Dun feasted him wishing observe his intent telling Cheng 'Great king refined plain fine gentleman—perhaps not general commander talent.'
units.literal: Dun feasted him wishing observe his intent telling Cheng 'Great king refined plain fine gentleman—perhaps not general commander talent.'

units.zh: 承曰：「公未見知耳，鉛刀豈不能一割乎！」
units.en: Cheng said, 'You have not taken my measure—a soft lead blade can still make one cut!'
units.literal: Cheng said, 'You have not taken my measure—a soft lead blade can still make one cut!'

units.zh: 承以敦欲測其情，故發此言。
units.en: He baited Dun with bravado on purpose.
units.literal: Cheng because Dun wished probe his feelings therefore uttered this speech.

units.zh: 敦果謂錢鳳曰：「彼不知懼而學壯語，此之不武，何能為也。」
units.en: Dun indeed told Qian Feng 'That one knows no fear yet learns brave speech—this lacking martial prowess what can he do.'
units.literal: Dun indeed told Qian Feng 'That one knows no fear yet learns brave speech—this lacking martial prowess what can he do.'

units.zh: 聽承之鎮。
units.en: Dun let him take his post.
units.literal: Allowed Cheng proceeding to garrison.

units.zh: 時湘土荒殘，公私困弊，承躬自儉約，乘葦茭車，而傾心綏撫，甚有能名。
units.en: Ruined Xiangzhou knew Cheng's reed-cart austerity and capable rule.
units.literal: At that time Xiang lands wasteland remnants public private exhausted Cheng personally frugal riding reed-mat wagon yet wholeheartedly soothing remarkably capable reputation.

units.en: Dun feigned a northern campaign to seize Cheng's boats.
units.literal: Dun feared him becoming personal disaster falsely claiming northern expedition altogether summoning Cheng district boats and carts.

units.zh: 承知其奸計，分半與之。
units.en: Cheng surrendered half his fleet to mask intent.
units.literal: Cheng knowing his treacherous scheme divided half giving him.

units.zh: 敦尋構難，遣參軍桓羆說承，以劉隗專寵，今便討擊，請承以為軍司，以軍期上道。
units.en: Dun sent Huan Pi demanding Cheng join as army director against Liu Wei at once.
units.literal: Dun soon raised disaster dispatching aide Huan Pi persuading Cheng citing Liu Wei exclusive favor now immediately attacking requesting Cheng as army director with army deadline departing road.

units.zh: 承歎曰：「吾其死矣！
units.en: Cheng sighed saying 'I suppose shall die!
units.literal: Cheng sighed saying 'I suppose shall die!

units.zh: 地荒人鮮，勢孤援絕。
units.en: Land wasteland people few situation isolated aid cut off.

units.en: Rushing lord's disaster loyalty;

units.en: Dying king's affair righteousness.

units.zh: 惟忠與義，夫復何求！」
units.en: Only loyalty with righteousness—what further seeking!'
units.literal: Only loyalty with righteousness—what further seeking!'

units.zh: 便欲唱義，而眾心疑惑。
units.en: He meant to rally troops though men wavered.
units.literal: Then wished to raise righteous cry yet hosts' hearts doubtful.

units.zh: 承曰：「吾受國恩，義無有貳。」
units.en: Cheng said 'I receive state grace righteousness permits no second thought.'
